title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四 太宗一
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四 太宗一 Volume 4 Annals 4: Taizong 1

sentences.zh: 帝幼不群，與他兒戲，皆畏服。

translations.literal: As a child the Emperor was unlike others; when he played with other boys, all feared and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a boy Taizong stood apart from his peers, and in their games the other children yielded to him in awe.

sentences.zh: 及長，隆準龍顏，望之知為大人，儼如也。

translations.literal: When grown, he had a lofty nose and dragon countenance; beholding him one knew he was a great man, stern and composed.
translations.idiomatic: Grown to manhood he bore the high nose and imperial visage of legend—any who saw him knew at once they faced a ruler, and he carried himself with unbroken gravity.

sentences.zh: 性嗜學，宣祖總兵淮南，破州縣，財物悉不取，第求古書遺帝，恆飭厲之，帝由是工文業，多藝能。

translations.literal: By nature he loved learning. When the Founding Ancestor commanded troops in Huainan and took prefectures and counties, he took none of the goods, only sought ancient books to send to the Emperor, and constantly admonished and encouraged him; the Emperor thereby became skilled in literary pursuits and had many talents.
translations.idiomatic: He was devoted to study. His father, while campaigning in Huainan, refused loot from captured towns and instead sent back antiquarian books for the young prince, urging him on until he mastered letters and a wide range of other arts.

sentences.zh: 開寶九年冬十月癸丑，太祖崩，帝遂即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In Kaibao year nine, winter, tenth month, on guichou, Taizu died; the Emperor thereupon assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the tenth month of winter, Kaibao year nine, Taizu died and Guangyi ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大赦，常赦所不原者咸除之。

translations.literal: On yimao, a great amnesty; what ordinary amnesties do not forgive was all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later he proclaimed a grand pardon that wiped away even crimes usually beyond forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，群臣表請聽政，不許；

translations.literal: On bingchen, the hundred officials memorialized requesting that he attend to government; he did not assent;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the court petitioned him to take up governance, but he refused;

sentences.zh: 丁巳，宰相薛居正等固請，乃許，即日移御長春殿。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Grand Councilors Xue Juzheng and others firmly petitioned; he then assented, and that same day moved the imperial residence to Everlasting Spring Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Xue Juzheng and the other chief ministers pressed again until he agreed, and that day he held court from Everlasting Spring Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以弟廷美為開封尹兼中書令，封齊王；

translations.literal: On gengshen, his younger brother Tingmei was made Metropolitan Governor concurrent with Secretariat Director and enfeoffed as Prince of Qi;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he named his brother Tingmei metropolitan governor and director of the Secretariat, with the title Prince of Qi;

sentences.zh: 先帝子德昭為永興軍節度使兼侍中，封武功郡王；

translations.literal: the late emperor's son Dezhao was made Yongxing circuit military commissioner concurrent with Palace Attendant and enfeoffed as Prince of Wugong commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's son Dezhao became commissioner of Yongxing with the rank of palace attendant and Prince of Wugong;

sentences.zh: 德芳為山南西道節度使、興元尹、同平章事。

translations.literal: Defang was made Shannan West circuit military commissioner, Xingyuan metropolitan governor, and Associate Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Defang received Shannan West circuit, the Xingyuan intendancy, and a seat as associate chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 薛居正加左僕射，沈倫加右僕射，盧多遜為中書侍郎，曹彬仍樞密使，並同平章事。

translations.literal: Xue Juzheng was promoted to Left Vice Director; Shen Lun to Right Vice Director; Lu Duosun to Secretariat Vice Director; Cao Bin remained Military Affairs Commissioner—all Associate Chief Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: He promoted Xue Juzheng to left vice director, Shen Lun to right vice director, and Lu Duosun to secretariat vice director while keeping Cao Bin as military affairs commissioner; all remained associate chief councilors.

sentences.zh: 楚昭輔為樞密使，潘美為宣徽南院使，內外官進秩有差。

translations.literal: Chu Zhaofu was made Military Affairs Commissioner; Pan Mei Palace Equerry of the Southern Court; inner and outer officials advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Zhaofu became military affairs commissioner, Pan Mei southern palace equerry, and officials throughout the bureaucracy received graded promotions.

sentences.zh: 詔茶、鹽、榷酤用開寶八年額。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that tea, salt, and monopoly wine use the Kaibao year eight quotas.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that tea, salt, and liquor monopolies stay at their Kaibao year eight revenue targets.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥朔，帝不視朝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guihai, the new-moon day, the Emperor did not hold audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon in the eleventh month he withheld court audience.

sentences.zh: 甲子，追冊故尹氏為淑德皇后，越國夫人符氏為懿德皇后。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the late Lady Yin was posthumously enfeoffed as Virtuous and Cultivated Empress; Lady Fu of Yue, the State Madame, as Cultivated and Virtuous Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he posthumously ennobled the late Lady Yin as Virtuous and Cultivated Empress and Lady Fu of Yue as Cultivated and Virtuous Empress.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷州縣奉戶。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the practice of supplying households to prefectures and counties was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he ended the system of assigned service households for local governments.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔諸道轉運使察州縣官吏能否，第為三等，歲終以聞。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict ordered transport commissioners in each circuit to assess whether prefectural and county officials were capable, rank them in three grades, and report at year's end.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he told circuit transport commissioners to grade every prefectural and county official into three tiers and file annual fitness reports.

sentences.zh: 命諸州大索知天文術數人送闕下，匿者論死。

translations.literal: He ordered the prefectures to search broadly for those who knew astronomy and numerology and send them to court; concealers were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered an empire-wide dragnet for astronomers and diviners to be sent to the capital, with death for anyone who hid them.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命權知高麗國事王伷為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On yihai, he ordered Wang Chang, who held provisional authority over Goryeo, to be King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he recognized Wang Chang, regent of Goryeo, as king of the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸相國寺。

translations.literal: On guiwei, he visited Xiangguo Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he went to Xiangguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣著作郎馮正、佐郎張玘使契丹告哀。

translations.literal: On jichou, he dispatched Drafting Secretary Feng Zheng and Assistant Drafting Secretary Zhang Qi as envoys to the Khitan to announce the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he sent drafting secretary Feng Zheng and assistant Zhang Qi to the Khitan court with news of Taizu's death.

sentences.zh: 詔文武官由譴累不齒者，有司毋得更論前過。

translations.literal: An edict stated that civil and military officials disqualified by cumulative demerits should not again have past faults raised by the offices.
translations.idiomatic: He barred the personnel offices from dredging up old offenses against officials already punished out of rank.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬戌，以大行殯，不視朝。

translations.literal: In year two, spring, first month, on renxu, because of the late emperor's coffining, he did not hold audience.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo year two, on the renxu new moon in the first month of spring, he suspended court for Taizu's encoffining rites.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禁居官出使者行商賈事。

translations.literal: On bingyin, officials on duty who went out as envoys were forbidden to engage in merchant trade.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he forbade serving officials on diplomatic missions from trading for profit.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，親試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he personally examined the Ministry of Rites examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he personally presided over the Ministry of Rites civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上大行皇帝諡曰英武聖文神德，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he bestowed the late emperor's posthumous title Martial, Sagely, Cultured, and Divine in Virtue, with temple name Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he gave Taizu the posthumous title Martial, Sagely, Cultured, and Divine in Virtue.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸相國寺，還御東華門觀燈。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he visited Xiangguo Monastery, then returned and viewed lanterns at the Eastern Flowery Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he visited Xiangguo Monastery and then watched lantern displays from the Eastern Flowery Gate.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，閱禮部貢士十舉至十五舉者百二十人，並賜出身。

translations.literal: On gengchen, he reviewed Ministry of Rites presented scholars who had taken the examination from ten to fifteen times—one hundred twenty persons—and all were granted jinshi status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he examined one hundred twenty candidates who had sat the exams between ten and fifteen times and granted them all jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命邕州廣源州酋長坦坦綽儂民富為檢校司空、御史大夫、上柱國。

translations.literal: On wuzi, he ordered Tan Tan Chuo, chief of Guangyuan prefecture in Yong prefecture, to be Acting Grand Master of the Palace, Censor-in-Chief, and Upper Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he named Tan Tan Chuo, chief of Guangyuan in Yongzhou, acting grand master, censor-in-chief, and upper pillar of state.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸講武池。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he went to the Boat-Training Pool.

sentences.zh: 置江南榷茶場。

translations.literal: A Jiangnan tea monopoly bureau was established.
translations.idiomatic: He set up a state tea monopoly for the lower Yangtze region.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，契丹遣使來賀即位及正旦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiawu, the Khitan sent envoys to congratulate him on his accession and the new year.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu, Khitan envoys arrived to congratulate his enthronement and the new year.

sentences.zh: 吳越國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The state of Wuyue sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyue dispatched tribute envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 罷南唐鐵錢。

translations.literal: Southern Tang iron coin was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew Southern Tang iron currency from circulation.

sentences.zh: 庚子，帝改名炅。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Emperor changed his name to Jiong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he took the taboo name Jiong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大宴崇德殿，不作樂。

translations.literal: On renyin, he held a great banquet in Chongde Hall and did not have music performed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he hosted a grand feast in Chongde Hall without music.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸新鑿池，遂幸講武池，宴射玉津園。

translations.literal: On yisi, he visited the newly dug pool, then visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Pool and held an archery feast in Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he toured the new imperial pond, then the Boat-Training Pool, and held an archery banquet in Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁未，占城國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Champa sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Champa dispatched tribute bearers.

sentences.zh: 己酉，令江南諸州鹽先通商處悉禁之。

translations.literal: On jiayou, he ordered that in all Jiangnan prefectures where salt had first been allowed free trade, the trade be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayou he reimposed the salt monopoly everywhere in Jiangnan that had briefly been opened to private commerce.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸太平興國寺，遂幸造船務。

translations.literal: On wuwu, he visited Taiping Xingguo Monastery, then visited the shipyard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he went to Taiping Xingguo Monastery and then inspected the imperial shipyard.

sentences.zh: 還幸建隆觀。

translations.literal: Returning, he visited Jianlong Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the way back he stopped at Jianlong Abbey.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌朔，始立試銜官選限。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renxu, the new-moon day, trial-rank official selection time limits were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon in the third month he instituted fixed terms for probationary officials awaiting formal appointment.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以河陽節度使趙普為太子少保。

translations.literal: On jimao, Heyang military commissioner Zhao Pu was made Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he demoted Heyang commissioner Zhao Pu to crown prince junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸開寶寺。

translations.literal: On jichou, he visited Kaibao Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he visited Kaibao Monastery.

sentences.zh: 置威勝軍。

translations.literal: Weisheng Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: He created Weisheng Army command.

sentences.zh: 禁江南諸州銅。

translations.literal: Copper in Jiangnan prefectures was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He banned private copper mining across Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 許契丹互市。

translations.literal: Border trade with the Khitan was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He authorized mutual markets along the Khitan frontier.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，大食國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinmao, the Dashi state sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinmao, the Abbasid caliphate sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，契丹遣使來會葬。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Khitan sent envoys to attend the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Khitan envoys arrived for Taizu's burial ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，葬太祖於永昌陵。

translations.literal: On yimao, Taizu was buried at Yongchang Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Taizu was interred at Yongchang Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，河南法曹參軍高丕、伊闕縣主簿翟嶙、鄭州滎澤令申廷溫坐不勤事，並免。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renxu, Henan legal aide Gao Pi, Yique county registrar Zhai Lin, and Zhengzhou Rongze magistrate Shen Tingwen, for not diligently performing duties, were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, he dismissed Henan legal aide Gao Pi, Yique registrar Zhai Lin, and Rongze magistrate Shen Tingwen for neglect of duty.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，向拱、張永德、張美、劉廷讓皆罷節鎮，為諸衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On guihai, Xiang Gong, Zhang Yongde, Zhang Mei, and Liu Tingrang were all removed as circuit commissioners and made generals-in-chief of the various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he stripped Xiang Gong, Zhang Yongde, Zhang Mei, and Liu Tingrang of their commands and named them generals-in-chief of the palace guards.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，幸新水磑，遂幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On yichou, he visited the new water mill, then visited Jade Ford Garden for an archery feast.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he toured the new imperial mill and held an archery banquet in Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔繼母殺子及婦者同殺人論。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered that stepmothers who kill sons and daughters-in-law be punished like murderers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he decreed that stepmothers who kill stepsons or daughters-in-law face the same penalty as common murderers.

sentences.zh: 庚午，宴崇德殿，不作樂。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he banqueted in Chongde Hall and did not have music performed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he feasted in Chongde Hall again without music.

sentences.zh: 遣辛仲甫使契丹。

translations.literal: He dispatched Xin Zhongfu as envoy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Xin Zhongfu to the Khitan court.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以十月七日為乾明節。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the seventh day of the tenth month was made the Qianming Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he declared the seventh day of the tenth month his birthday festival, Qianming.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祔太祖神主於廟，以孝明皇后王氏配；

translations.literal: On jimao, Taizu's spirit tablet was enshrined in the ancestral temple, with Empress Xiaoming Wang as consort;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he installed Taizu's spirit tablet in the ancestral temple with Empress Xiaoming Wang as his consort;

sentences.zh: 又以懿德皇后符氏、淑德皇后尹氏祔別廟。

translations.literal: Cultivated and Virtuous Empress Fu and Virtuous and Cultivated Empress Yin were also enshrined in separate temples.
translations.idiomatic: and gave Empresses Fu and Yin their own affiliated shrines.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔作北帝宮于終南山。

translations.literal: On gengchen, an edict ordered construction of the Northern Thearch Palace on Zhongnan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he ordered a Northern Thearch Palace built on Zhongnan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸新水磑，遂宴射玉津園。

translations.literal: On guiwei, he visited the new water mill, then held an archery feast in Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he visited the new water mill and again held an archery banquet in Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，白龍見邠州要策池中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinmao, the new-moon day, a white dragon appeared in Yaoc Pond at Bin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon in the sixth month a white dragon was reported in Yaoc Pond at Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸開寶寺，遂幸飛龍院，賜從官馬。

translations.literal: On yimao, he visited Kaibao Monastery, then visited Flying Dragon Hall, and bestowed horses on attending officials.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he visited Kaibao Monastery and Flying Dragon Hall and gave horses to his entourage.

sentences.zh: 是月，磁州保安等縣墨蟲生，食桑葉殆盡。

translations.literal: That month, at Baoan and other counties in Ci prefecture ink-worms were born and nearly devoured all mulberry leaves.
translations.idiomatic: That month ink-worms at Baoan and neighboring counties in Cizhou stripped the mulberry orchards bare.

sentences.zh: 潁州大水。

translations.literal: Ying prefecture suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，詔諸庫藏敢變權衡以取羨餘者死。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, an edict ordered that whoever in the storehouses dared alter the weights and scales to take surplus profit be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu, he decreed death for treasury clerks who rigged scales to skim surplus goods.

sentences.zh: 癸未，鉅鹿、沙河步屈食桑、麥，河決滎澤、頓丘、白馬、溫縣。

translations.literal: On guiwei, at Julu and Shahe, foot-worms devoured mulberry and wheat; the Yellow River broke at Rongze, Dunqiu, Baima, and Wen counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei caterpillars ravaged Julu and Shahe, while the Yellow River burst through dikes at Rongze, Dunqiu, Baima, and Wen.

sentences.zh: 閏月己亥，幸白鶻橋，臨金水河。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jihai, he visited White Crane Bridge and looked out over the Goldwater River.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jihai, he went to White Crane Bridge to view the Goldwater River.

sentences.zh: 己酉，河溢開封等八縣，害稼。

translations.literal: On jiayou, the river overflowed in Kaifeng and eight other counties and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayou floods in Kaifeng and eight neighboring counties destroyed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔發潭州兵擊梅山洞賊。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict ordered troops raised in Tan prefecture to attack the bandits of Meishan Cave.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he ordered Tanzhou troops to suppress the Meishan Cave rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，有司上閏年輿地版籍之圖。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the offices presented the intercalary-year territorial register maps.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the bureaucracy submitted revised territorial registers for the intercalary year.

sentences.zh: 令支郡得專奏事。

translations.literal: He ordered that subordinate prefectures might memorialize directly.
translations.idiomatic: He allowed dependent prefectures to send memorials to court on their own.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，黎州兩林蠻來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guihai, the Two Forests tribes of Li prefecture came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, the Two Forests Yi of Lizhou presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，平海軍節度使陳洪進來朝。

translations.literal: On yichou, Pinghai Army military commissioner Chen Hongjin came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Pinghai commissioner Chen Hongjin arrived at court in person.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以觀燈遂幸相國寺。

translations.literal: On guiyou, because of viewing lanterns he then visited Xiangguo Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, after watching lantern displays, he went on to Xiangguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔作崇聖殿。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict ordered construction of Chong Sage Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he ordered Chong Sage Hall built.

sentences.zh: 是月，陝、澶、道、忠、壽諸州大水，鉅鹿步蝻生，景城縣雹。

translations.literal: That month, Shan, Zhen, Dao, Zhong, and Shou prefectures suffered great flood; at Julu foot-worms were born; Jingcheng county had hail.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods struck Shan, Zhen, Dao, Zhong, and Shou; caterpillars appeared at Julu and hail battered Jingcheng county.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，幸弓箭院，遂幸新修三館。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yiwei, he visited the Bow and Arrow Directorate, then visited the newly renovated Three Halls.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiwei, he toured the Bow and Arrow Directorate and the newly rebuilt Three Halls.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸新水磑，遂幸西御園宴射。

translations.literal: On renyin, he visited the new water mill, then visited the Western Imperial Garden for an archery feast.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he visited the new water mill and held an archery banquet in the Western Imperial Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁未，渤尼國遣使來貢，山後兩林蠻來獻馬。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Borneo sent envoys bearing tribute; the Two Forests tribes beyond the mountains came presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Borneo sent tribute envoys, and the mountain Two Forests Yi brought horses.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸講武台大閱。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Terrace for a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he held a great military review at the Lecture Terrace.

sentences.zh: 容州初貢珠。

translations.literal: Rong prefecture first presented pearls as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzhou sent pearl tribute for the first time.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，鎮海、鎮東軍節度使錢惟濬來朝。

translations.literal: On yimao, Zhenhai and Zhendong Army military commissioner Qian Weijun came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhenhai and Zhendong commissioner Qian Weijun arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，狩近郊。

translations.literal: On bingchen, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he hunted outside the capital walls.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，吳越王遣使乞呼名，不允。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the king of Wuyue sent envoys requesting permission to be addressed by personal name; he did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the king of Wuyue asked leave to be called by his personal name in imperial documents; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 是月，興州江水溢，濮州大水，汴水溢。

translations.literal: That month, the Jiang overflowed at Xing prefecture; Pu prefecture suffered great flood; the Bian Canal overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jiang rose at Xingzhou, Pu prefecture flooded, and the Bian Canal burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔，賜百官及在外將校、長吏冬服。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuwu, the new-moon day, winter garments were bestowed on the hundred officials and on generals and chief officials outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon in the tenth month of winter he issued winter uniforms to the court and to field commanders and circuit intendants.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，契丹來賀乾明節。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Khitan came to congratulate the Qianming Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Khitan envoys arrived for the Qianming birthday celebrations.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸京城西北，觀衛士與契丹使騎射，遂宴苑中。

translations.literal: On jisi, he visited the northwest of the capital, watched guardsmen and Khitan envoys compete in mounted archery, and then banqueted in the park.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he rode to the northwest suburbs to watch his guards and Khitan envoys shoot from horseback, then feasted in the imperial park.

sentences.zh: 己巳，群臣請舉樂，表三上，從之。

translations.literal: On jisi, the hundred officials requested that music be performed; they memorialized three times, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the court thrice petitioned for music at court; on the third memorial he relented.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔禁天文卜相等書，私習者斬。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict forbade books on astronomy and divination; private study was punished by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he banned astrological and divinatory texts and made private study a capital offense.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he hunted again near the capital.

sentences.zh: 初榷酒酤。

translations.literal: A wine monopoly was first imposed.
translations.idiomatic: He instituted the state liquor monopoly.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥朔，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dinghai, the new-moon day, the sun was eclipsed; it was total.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon in the eleventh month a total solar eclipse darkened the sky.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，日南至，帝始受朝。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the winter solstice; the Emperor first received court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the winter solstice, he held his first formal audience of the season.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣李瀆等賀契丹正旦。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he dispatched Li Du and others to congratulate the Khitan new year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he sent Li Du and a party to the Khitan court for the new year.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禁江南諸州新小錢，私鑄者棄市。

translations.literal: On dingyou, new small coins in Jiangnan prefectures were forbidden; private casting was punished by execution in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he outlawed new lightweight coins in Jiangnan and made private minting a capital crime.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸御龍弓箭直營，賜軍士錢帛有差。

translations.literal: On guichou, he visited the Imperial Dragon Bow and Arrow Guards camp and bestowed money and silks on the soldiers by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he inspected the Imperial Dragon Bow and Arrow Guards and rewarded the men with graded gifts of cash and silk.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙戌朔，不受朝，群臣詣閣賀。

translations.literal: In year three, spring, first month, on bingxu, the new-moon day, he did not receive audience; the hundred officials went to the gate to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In year three, on the bingxu new moon in the first month of spring, he withheld throne audience while officials offered new-year greetings at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，殿直霍瓊坐募兵劫民財，腰斬。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Palace Duty Officer Huo Qiong, for recruiting soldiers and robbing commoners' property, was cut in two at the waist.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin palace duty officer Huo Qiong was bisected at the waist for using recruits to rob civilians.

sentences.zh: 甲午，浚汾河。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Fen River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu work crews dredged the Fen River.

sentences.zh: 雅州西山野川路蠻來朝。

translations.literal: The Yechuan Road barbarians of western Ya prefecture came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal leaders from the Yechuan Road in western Ya prefecture presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，開襄、漢漕渠，渠成而水不上，卒廢。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Xiang and Han transport canal was opened; the canal was completed but the water would not rise, and in the end it was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he opened a canal linking Xiang and Han, but when the channel would not fill with water the project was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 己亥，光祿丞李之才坐擅入酒邀同列飲殿中，除名。

translations.literal: On jihai, Court Gentleman for Ceremonies Li Zhicai, for presuming to enter the hall and invite colleagues to drink wine, was struck from the roster.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai court gentleman Li Zhicai was expelled for sneaking wine into the palace hall and hosting an unauthorized drinking party.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷陳州蔡河舟算。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Cai River boat toll at Chen prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he ended the Cai River ferry tax at Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，浚廣濟、惠民及蔡三河，治黃河隄。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Guangji, Huimin, and Cai rivers were dredged, and Yellow River dikes were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he dredged the Guangji, Huimin, and Cai canals and strengthened the Yellow River levees.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，浚汴口。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Bian Canal mouth was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi crews cleared the mouth of the Bian Canal.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命修太祖實錄。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he ordered compilation of the Veritable Records of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he ordered the drafting of Taizu's Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命群臣禱雨。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he ordered the hundred officials to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he commanded the court to conduct rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，京畿雨足。

translations.literal: On guichou, rain in the capital region was sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the capital region received adequate rain.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，幸鄭國公主第。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingchen, he visited the Princess of Zheng's residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingchen, he called at the Princess of Zheng's mansion.

sentences.zh: 以三館新修書院為崇文院。

translations.literal: The newly renovated book hall of the Three Halls was made the Hall of Respect for Culture.
translations.idiomatic: He renamed the Three Halls' new library the Hall of Respect for Culture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔班諸州錄事、縣令、簿尉曆子合書式。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict ordered that the record books of prefectural clerks and county magistrates, registrars, and assistants follow a uniform format.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he standardized the logbooks kept by circuit clerks, county magistrates, registrars, and assistants.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷昌州七井虛額鹽。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the fictitious salt quota at the seven wells of Chang prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he canceled the phantom salt quota for Changzhou's seven wells.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，泗州錄事參軍徐璧坐監倉受賄出虛券，棄市。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Sizhou recorder Xu Bi, for supervising the granary, taking bribes, and issuing false warehouse certificates, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Sizhou recorder Xu Bi was executed for taking bribes and issuing false grain receipts while overseeing the state granary.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸西綾錦院，命近臣觀織室機杼，還幸崇文院觀書。

translations.literal: On xinwei, he visited the Western Brocade Directorate, ordered close officials to observe the weaving rooms' looms, then visited the Hall of Respect for Culture to view books.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he toured the Western Brocade Directorate with his intimates to watch the looms, then went to the Hall of Respect for Culture to browse the collections.

sentences.zh: 詔鑿金明池。

translations.literal: An edict ordered excavation of the Golden Bright Pool.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Golden Bright Pool dug.

sentences.zh: 甲申，禁沿邊諸郡闌出銅錢。

translations.literal: On jiashen, border prefectures were forbidden to smuggle copper cash out.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he barred frontier prefectures from exporting copper coin.

sentences.zh: 製西京新修殿名。

translations.literal: Names were devised for the newly renovated halls of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He assigned new names to the renovated halls of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉朔，貝州清河民田祚十世同居，詔旌其門閭，復其家。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yiyou, the new-moon day, Tian Zuo of Qinghe in Bei prefecture had ten generations dwelling together; an edict honored his gate and lane and remitted his household taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon in the third month he honored Tian Zuo of Qinghe in Beizhou, where ten generations lived under one roof, with an inscribed gate and tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，監海門戍、殿直武裕坐姦贓棄市。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Supervisor of the Sea Gate Garrison and Palace Duty Officer Wu Yu, for adultery and corruption, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou sea-gate garrison supervisor Wu Yu was executed for adultery and graft.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，秦州言，戎酋王泥豬寇八狼戍，巡檢劉崇讓擊敗之，梟其首以徇。

translations.literal: On renyin, Qin prefecture reported that Rong chieftain Wang Nizhu attacked Balang Garrison; inspector Liu Chongrang defeated him and displayed the head as warning.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Qinzhou reported that Rong chieftain Wang Nizhu had raided Balang Garrison; inspector Liu Chongrang routed him and exposed his head as a warning.

sentences.zh: 己酉，吳越國王錢俶來朝。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the king of Wuyue, Qian Chu, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the king of Wuyue, Qian Chu, arrived at court in person.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸開寶寺。

translations.literal: On renzi, he visited Kaibao Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he visited Kaibao Monastery.

sentences.zh: 是月，壽州甘露降。

translations.literal: That month, sweet dew fell at Shou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month sweet dew was reported at Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯朔，命群臣禱雨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yimao, the new-moon day, he ordered the hundred officials to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon in the fourth month of summer he again ordered rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 召華山道士丁少微。

translations.literal: Mount Hua Daoist Ding Shaowei was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned Mount Hua Daoist Ding Shaowei to court.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，禁民自春及秋毋捕獵。

translations.literal: On bingchen, commoners were forbidden from spring through autumn to hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he banned civilian hunting from spring through autumn.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸建隆觀，遂幸西染院，又幸造船務。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he visited Jianlong Abbey, then visited the Western Dye Directorate, then visited the shipyard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he toured Jianlong Abbey, the Western Dye Directorate, and the imperial shipyard.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置諸道轉運判官。

translations.literal: On yihai, transport-assistant commissioners were established in each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he created assistant transport commissioners in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，陳洪進獻漳、泉二州，凡得縣十四、戶十五萬一千九百七十八、兵萬八千七百二十七。

translations.literal: On jimao, Chen Hongjin presented Zhang and Quan prefectures—fourteen counties in all, one hundred fifty-one thousand nine hundred seventy-eight households, and eighteen thousand seven hundred twenty-seven troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Chen Hongjin surrendered Zhang and Quan prefectures: fourteen counties, 151,978 households, and 18,727 troops.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幸城南觀麥，遂幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On gengchen, he visited the southern suburbs to view the wheat, then visited Jade Ford Garden for an archery feast.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he rode south to inspect the wheat fields and then held an archery banquet in Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，侍御史趙承嗣坐監市征隱官錢，棄市。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Attending Censor Zhao Chengsi, for supervising market tolls and concealing official funds, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi attending censor Zhao Chengsi was executed for embezzling market taxes he was charged to collect.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以陳洪進為武寧軍節度使、同平章事。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Chen Hongjin was made Wuning Army military commissioner and Associate Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he named Chen Hongjin commissioner of Wuning Army and associate chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 錢俶乞罷所封吳越國王，及解天下兵馬大元帥，並寢書詔不名之命，歸其兵甲，求還，不許。

translations.literal: Qian Chu requested to relinquish his enfeoffment as king of Wuyue and to resign as overall commander of all armies and horses under Heaven, and also asked that the edict privilege of not using his personal name be withdrawn, that his weapons be returned, and that he be allowed to depart—none was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Chu asked to surrender his title as king of Wuyue, resign as commander-in-chief of all forces, give up the privilege of being addressed without his personal name, hand back his arms, and return home—the emperor refused every request.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決獲嘉縣。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River broke at Huojia county.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River breached the dikes at Huojia.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，赦漳、泉，仍給復一年。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou, Zhang and Quan were amnestied and given tax remission for one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiyou, he pardoned Zhang and Quan and granted a one-year tax holiday.

sentences.zh: 錢俶獻其兩浙諸州，凡得州十三、軍一、縣八十六、戶五十五萬六百八十、兵一十一萬五千三十六。

translations.literal: Qian Chu presented all his Two Zhe prefectures—thirteen prefectures, one army, eighty-six counties, five hundred fifty thousand six hundred eighty households, and one hundred fifteen thousand thirty-six troops in all.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Chu surrendered the Two Zhes: thirteen prefectures, one army, eighty-six counties, 550,680 households, and 115,036 troops.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封錢俶為淮海國王，其子惟濬徙淮南軍節度使，惟治徙鎮國軍節度使。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Qian Chu was enfeoffed as king of Huaihai; his son Weijun was transferred to Huainan Army military commissioner, and Weizhi to Zhenguo Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he enfeoffed Qian Chu as king of Huaihai, moved his son Weijun to Huainan Army, and transferred Weizhi to Zhenguo Army.

sentences.zh: 戊子，赦兩浙，給復如漳、泉。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Two Zhes were amnestied and given tax remission like Zhang and Quan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he pardoned the Two Zhes and granted the same tax relief as Zhang and Quan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣李從吉等使契丹。

translations.literal: On guisi, he dispatched Li Congji and others as envoys to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he sent Li Congji and others to the Khitan court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，占城國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Champa sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Champa sent envoys bearing regional goods.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，定難軍節度使李克叡卒，子繼筠立。

translations.literal: On renyin, Dingnan Army military commissioner Li Kerui died; his son Jiyun succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Dingnan commissioner Li Kerui died and his son Jiyun took over.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以繼筠襲定難軍節度使。

translations.literal: On yisi, Jiyun inherited the post of Dingnan Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he confirmed Jiyun as commissioner of Dingnan Army.

sentences.zh: 幸殿前都指揮使楊信第視疾。

translations.literal: He visited the residence of Palace Front commander Yang Xin to see him in illness.
translations.idiomatic: He called at palace front commander Yang Xin's home to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以秦州節度判官李若愚子飛雄矯制乘驛至清水縣，縛都巡檢周承瑨及劉文裕、馬知節等七人，將劫守卒據城為叛，文裕覺其詐，禽縛飛雄按之，盡得其狀，詔誅飛雄及其父母妻子同產，而哀若愚宗奠無主，申戒中外臣庶，自今子弟有素懷兇險、屢戒不悛者，尊長聞諸州縣，錮送闕下，配隸遠處，隱不以聞，坐及期功以上。

translations.literal: On wushen, Qin prefecture military affairs judge Li Ruoyu's son Feixiong forged an edict, took post-horses to Qingshui county, bound chief inspector Zhou Chengyong and Liu Wenyu, Ma Zhijie, and seven others, and was about to seize the garrison troops and hold the city in rebellion; Wenyu perceived the fraud, seized and bound Feixiong and investigated— the full plot was obtained; an edict executed Feixiong together with his parents, wife, children, and siblings of the same womb, yet pitied Ruoyu's clan for having no one to perform the ancestral offerings; an admonition was issued to civil and military officials within and without: from now on, if sons and younger brothers by nature harbor fierce treachery and repeated admonitions do not reform them, the elders should report to the prefectures and counties, send them shackled to court, and assign them to distant penal service; concealing without reporting implicates collaterals through first cousins and above.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Feixiong, son of Qinzhou judge Li Ruoyu, forged an imperial order, seized relay horses to Qingshui, bound chief inspector Zhou Chengyong with Liu Wenyu, Ma Zhijie, and five others, and tried to turn the garrison against the throne; Wenyu saw through the plot, captured him, and laid bare the conspiracy. The emperor executed Feixiong with his parents, wife, children, and full siblings, yet mourned that Ruoyu's line had no one left to tend the ancestral rites. He warned officials everywhere that hereafter, when younger kinsmen showed incorrigible violence, elders must report them to local authorities for shipment to the capital and exile—or face punishment through first cousins if they hid the truth.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，大雨震電，西窰務藁聚焚。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on yiyou, great rain, thunder, and lightning; the straw stores of the Western Kiln Office burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiyou, a thunderstorm set the Western Kiln Office's haystacks ablaze.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，右千牛衛上將軍李煜卒，追封吳王。

translations.literal: On renchen, Right Thousand Bull Guards general-in-chief Li Yu died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the former Southern Tang ruler Li Yu died and was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金鄉縣民李光襲十世同居，詔旌其門。

translations.literal: On wuxu, commoner Li Guangxi of Jinxiang county had ten generations dwelling together; an edict honored his gate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he honored the gate of Li Guangxi of Jinxiang, where ten generations lived together.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，改明德門為丹鳳門。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Bright Virtue Gate was renamed Vermilion Phoenix Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he renamed Bright Virtue Gate Vermilion Phoenix Gate.

sentences.zh: 壬子，中書令史李知古坐受賕擅改刑部所定法，杖殺之。

translations.literal: On renzi, Secretariat clerk Li Zhigu, for taking bribes and presumptuously altering the law as fixed by the Ministry of Justice, was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi secretariat clerk Li Zhigu was beaten to death for taking bribes and rewriting sentences the Ministry of Justice had already set.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，幸南造船務，遂幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guichou, he visited the southern shipyard, then visited Jade Ford Garden for an archery feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, he inspected the southern shipyard and held an archery banquet in Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 滑州黃河清。

translations.literal: The Yellow River at Huazhou ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River at Huazhou ran clear—a portent of peace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔兩浙發淮海王緦麻以上親及管內官吏赴闕。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict ordered the Two Zhes to send Huaihai King's relatives in the five mourning grades and above and officials within the circuit to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he ordered the Two Zhes to bring Qian Chu's relatives in mourning dress and all circuit officials to the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛未，夷州蠻任朗政來貢。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Yi chieftain Ren Langzheng of Yi prefecture came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Yi chieftain Ren Langzheng of Yizhou presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詹事丞徐選坐贓，杖殺之。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Household Administration aide Xu Xuan, for corruption, was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou household administration aide Xu Xuan was beaten to death for graft.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，群臣請上尊號曰應運統天聖明文武皇帝，許之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the hundred officials requested that he be given the honorific title Emperor Responsive to the Mandate, Unifying Heaven, Sagely, Bright, Martial, and Cultured; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the court petitioned for the honorific Responsive to the Mandate, Unifying Heaven, Sagely, Bright, Martial, and Cultured—and he accepted.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，親試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiashen, he personally examined the Ministry of Rites examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen, he again presided over the civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以布衣張遯為襄邑縣主簿，張文旦濮陽縣主簿。

translations.literal: On renzi, commoner Zhang Dun was made Xiangyi county chief clerk, and Zhang Wendan Puyang county chief clerk.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he appointed commoners Zhang Dun and Zhang Wendan chief clerks of Xiangyi and Puyang counties.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑朔，契丹遣使來賀乾明節。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guichou, the new-moon day, the Khitan sent envoys to congratulate the Qianming Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon in the tenth month of winter, Khitan envoys arrived for Qianming.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The king of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸武功郡王德昭邸，遂幸齊王邸，賜齊王銀萬兩、絹萬匹，德昭、德芳有差。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he visited the residence of Prince of Wugong Dezhao, then visited the Prince of Qi's residence, bestowing on the Prince of Qi ten thousand taels of silver and ten thousand bolts of silk; Dezhao and Defang received gifts by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he called on Dezhao at the Prince of Wugong's mansion and then on Tingmei, giving the Prince of Qi ten thousand taels of silver and ten thousand bolts of silk while rewarding Dezhao and Defang in proportion.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，復兗州曲阜縣襲封文宣公家。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the hereditary fief of the Duke of Cultural Propagation in Qufu, Yan prefecture, was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he restored the hereditary Confucian dukedom at Qufu in Yan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he hunted outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決靈河縣。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River broke at Linghe county.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River breached the dikes at Linghe.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, he offered the suburban sacrifice at the Round Mound and proclaimed a grand amnesty.

sentences.zh: 御乾元殿受尊號。

translations.literal: At Qianyuan Hall he received the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: He received the new honorific title in Qianyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸齊王邸。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he visited the Prince of Qi's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he visited Tingmei again.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以郊祀，中外文武加恩。

translations.literal: On bingwu, because of the suburban sacrifice, civil and military officials within and without received grace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he rewarded the entire civil and military roster for the suburban rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，幸講武台觀機石連弩。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yichou, he visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Terrace to view the repeating crossbow and stone-thrower machines.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yichou, he inspected repeating crossbows and traction catapults at the Lecture Terrace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he hunted again near the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，契丹遣使來賀正旦。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Khitan sent envoys to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Khitan envoys arrived for the new year.

sentences.zh: 己卯，置三司推官、巡官。

translations.literal: On jimao, investigative and touring officials of the Three Bureaus were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he created investigative and touring posts within the Three Fiscal Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁亥，命太子中允張洎、著作佐郎句中正使高麗，告以北伐。

translations.literal: In year four, spring, first month, on dinghai, he ordered Crown Prince Middle Adviser Zhang Bi and Drafting Assistant Gou Zhongzheng as envoys to Goryeo to announce the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In year four, on dinghai in the first month of spring, he sent Zhang Bi and Gou Zhongzheng to Goryeo with word of the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 遣官分督諸州軍儲輸太原行營。

translations.literal: He dispatched officials to supervise each prefecture and army in transporting provisions to the Taiyuan field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He sent overseers to every prefecture and command to rush grain to the Taiyuan campaign base.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以宣徽南院使潘美為北路都招討制置使，分命節度使河陽崔彥進、彰德李漢瓊、彰信劉遇、桂州觀察使曹翰，副以衛府將直，四面進討。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Palace Equerry of the Southern Court Pan Mei was made overall commander and director of the Northern Route; he separately ordered Heyang military commissioner Cui Yanjin, Zhangde Li Hanqiong, Zhangxin Liu Yu, and Guizhou observation commissioner Cao Han, with guard generals as deputies, to advance and attack from four sides.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he named southern palace equerry Pan Mei overall commander of the northern front and ordered Cui Yanjin of Heyang, Li Hanqiong of Zhangde, Liu Yu of Zhangxin, and Cao Han of Guizhou, each with guard generals as deputies, to close on Taiyuan from four directions.

sentences.zh: 侍衛馬軍都虞候米信、步軍都虞候田重進並為行營指揮使，將其軍以從，西上閣門使郭守文、順州團練使梁迥監護之。

translations.literal: Palace Horse Guards vice commander Mi Xin and Foot Guards vice commander Tian Chongjin were both made campaign commanders and led their armies to follow; Western Upper Gate envoy Guo Shouwen and Shunzhou training commissioner Liang Jiong supervised them.
translations.idiomatic: Horse guards vice commander Mi Xin and foot guards vice commander Tian Chongjin became field commanders under Pan Mei, with palace envoy Guo Shouwen and Shunzhou commissioner Liang Jiong as supervisors.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命雲州觀察使郭進為太原石嶺關都部署，以斷燕薊援師。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Yunzhou observation commissioner Guo Jin was made overall deployer of Shiling Pass at Taiyuan to cut off Yan and Ji relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he stationed Guo Jin at Shiling Pass to block Khitan reinforcements from Yan and Ji.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，置簽署樞密院事，以石熙載為之。

translations.literal: On guisi, the post of Signatory for Military Affairs was established; Shi Xizai was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he created the signatory post at the Bureau of Military Affairs and named Shi Xizai to fill it.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宴潘美等于長春殿，賜以襲衣、金帶、鞍馬。

translations.literal: On yiwei, he banqueted Pan Mei and others in Everlasting Spring Hall and bestowed robes, gold belts, and saddled horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he feasted Pan Mei and the other commanders in Everlasting Spring Hall and gave them robes, gold belts, and horses.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，新渾儀成。

translations.literal: On guimao, the new armillary sphere was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the court's new armillary sphere was finished.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，幸國子監，遂幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi, he visited the Directorate of Education, then visited Jade Ford Garden for an archery feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renzi, he toured the Directorate of Education and held an archery banquet in Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以齊王廷美子德恭為貴州防禦使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Prince of Qi Tingmei's son Degong was made Guizhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he made Tingmei's son Degong defense commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以中書侍郎、尚書右僕射、同平章事沈倫為東京留守兼判開封府事，宣徽北院使王仁贍為大內都部署，樞密承旨陳從信副之。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Secretariat Vice Director, Right Vice Director, and Associate Chief Councilor Shen Lun was made Eastern Capital regent concurrent with acting Metropolitan Governor; Northern Court Palace Equerry Wang Renzan was made overall deployer of the Inner Palace, with Military Affairs Commissioner Chen Congxin as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he left Shen Lun in Kaifeng as eastern capital regent and acting metropolitan governor, named Wang Renzan chief of the inner palace garrison, and made Chen Congxin his deputy.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜扈從近臣鞍馬、衣服、金玉帶有差。

translations.literal: On guihai, attending close officials were bestowed saddled horses, clothing, and jade belts by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he rewarded his entourage with graded gifts of horses, robes, and jade belts.

sentences.zh: 甲子，帝發京師。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Emperor departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he marched north from the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，次澶州，觀魚於河。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he halted at Zhen prefecture and watched fish in the river.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he paused at Zhenzhou and watched fish in the river.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰朔，次鎮州。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, the new-moon day, he halted at Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon in the third month his headquarters remained at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，郭進破北漢西龍門砦，禽獲甚眾。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Guo Jin broke Northern Han's Western Dragon Gate fort and captured a great host.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Guo Jin stormed Northern Han's Western Dragon Gate fort and took many prisoners.

sentences.zh: 乙未，郭進大破契丹於關南。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Guo Jin greatly defeated the Khitan south of the pass.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Guo Jin routed the Khitan army south of the pass.

sentences.zh: 庚子，左飛龍使史業破北漢鷹揚軍，俘百人來獻。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Left Flying Dragon envoy Shi Ye broke Northern Han's Hawk-raise Army and presented one hundred captives.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi flying-dragon envoy Shi Ye shattered Northern Han's Hawk-raise Army and sent a hundred captives to court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，夏州李繼筠乞帥所部助討北漢。

translations.literal: On yisi, Xia prefecture's Li Jiyun requested to lead his troops to assist in attacking Northern Han.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Jiyun of Xia prefecture offered his Tangut troops for the Taiyuan campaign.

sentences.zh: 詔泉州發兵護送陳洪進親屬赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Quan prefecture to raise troops to escort Chen Hongjin's kin to court.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Quanzhou to dispatch troops to escort Chen Hongjin's family to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉朔，嵐州行營與北漢軍戰，破之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiyou, the new-moon day, the Lan prefecture field headquarters fought Northern Han troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou new moon in the fourth month of summer, the Lanzhou column defeated a Northern Han force.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，盂縣降。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Yu county surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Yu county surrendered.

sentences.zh: 以石熙載為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Shi Xizai was made Military Affairs Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He promoted Shi Xizai to vice commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以孟玄喆、劉廷翰為兵馬都鈐轄，崔翰總馬步軍，並駐泊鎮州。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Meng Xuanzhe and Liu Tinghan were made overall commanders of horse and foot, and Cui Han commanded all horse and foot armies—all stationed at Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he named Meng Xuanzhe and Liu Tinghan overall battlefield commanders, with Cui Han directing all cavalry and infantry, and held them at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，帝發鎮州。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Emperor departed Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he marched north from Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 折御卿克岢嵐軍，獲其軍使折令圖。

translations.literal: Zhe Yuqing took Ke Lan Army and captured its military commissioner Zhe Lingtu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe Yuqing seized Ke Lan garrison and took its commander Zhe Lingtu prisoner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，克隆州，獲其招討使李詢等六人。

translations.literal: On yichou, Long prefecture was taken; its pacification commissioner Li Xun and six others were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Long prefecture fell, and pacification commissioner Li Xun with six others were captured.

sentences.zh: 己巳，折御卿克嵐州，殺其憲州刺史郭翊，獲夔州節度使馬延忠。

translations.literal: On jisi, Zhe Yuqing took Lan prefecture, killed its Xianzhou prefect Guo Yi, and captured Kuizhou military commissioner Ma Yanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhe Yuqing seized Lanzhou, executed Xianzhou prefect Guo Yi, and took Kuizhou commissioner Ma Yanzhong prisoner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次太原，駐蹕汾東行營。

translations.literal: On gengwu he halted at Taiyuan and encamped at the field headquarters east of the Fen River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he reached Taiyuan and pitched camp at the eastern Fen River headquarters.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸太原城，詔諭北漢主劉繼元使降。

translations.literal: On xinwei he visited Taiyuan city and issued an edict urging Northern Han ruler Liu Jiyuan to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he entered Taiyuan and sent word commanding Liu Jiyuan of Northern Han to yield the city.

sentences.zh: 壬申夜，帝幸城西，督諸將發機石攻城。

translations.literal: On the night of renshen the Emperor went to the west of the city and supervised the generals in launching traction-stone engines against the walls.
translations.idiomatic: That night, on renshen, he rode to the western walls and directed his generals as trebuchets hurled stone against the ramparts.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸諸砦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he visited the various encampments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he made the rounds of the siege camps.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸連城，視攻城諸洞。

translations.literal: On yihai he visited the linked encampments and inspected the siege tunnels.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he toured the linked siege lines and examined the assault galleries.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯朔，攻城西南，遂陷羊馬城，獲其宣徽使范超，斬纛下。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jimao new moon, he attacked the southwest; the sheep-and-horse rampart was then taken, and Northern Han Xuanhui commissioner Fan Chao was captured and beheaded below the army standard.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon in the fifth month he struck the southwest wall, carried the livestock rampart, seized Fan Chao of the Xuanhui office, and beheaded him before the banners.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，攻城西北。

translations.literal: On xinsi he attacked the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the assault shifted to the northwest face.

sentences.zh: 壬午，其騎帥郭萬超來降，遂移幸城南，手詔賜繼元。

translations.literal: On renwu their cavalry commander Guo Wanchao came to surrender; the Emperor thereupon moved his camp to the south of the city and personally wrote an edict bestowed on Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Guo Wanchao, commander of the Han cavalry, defected; the emperor shifted south of the city and sent Jiyuan a letter in his own hand.

sentences.zh: 癸未，進攻，將士盡奮，若將屠之。

translations.literal: On guimo he pressed the attack; officers and soldiers exerted themselves to the full, as if about to slaughter the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guimo the assault reached its fiercest pitch—officers and men fought as though the city were to be put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 是夜，繼元遣使納款。

translations.literal: That night Jiyuan sent an envoy to submit.
translations.idiomatic: That night Jiyuan sent envoys to offer surrender.

sentences.zh: 甲申，繼元降，北漢平，凡得州十、縣四十、戶三萬五千二百二十。

translations.literal: On jiashen Jiyuan surrendered; Northern Han was pacified. In all there were gained ten prefectures, forty counties, and thirty-five thousand two hundred twenty households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Jiyuan capitulated and Northern Han fell—ten prefectures, forty counties, and 35,220 households added to the realm.

sentences.zh: 命祠部郎中劉保勛知太原府。

translations.literal: He ordered Ministry of Rites langzhong Liu Baoxun to administer Taiyuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He put Ministry of Rites langzhong Liu Baoxun in charge of Taiyuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，赦河東常赦所不原者，命錄死事將校子孫，瘞戰士。

translations.literal: On yiyou he pardoned in Hedong those whom ordinary amnesties do not forgive, ordered the recording of the sons and grandsons of officers who died in service, and buried the war dead.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he extended pardon in Hedong even to crimes beyond the usual amnesty, enrolled the heirs of fallen commanders, and interred the slain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以榆次縣為新并州。

translations.literal: On wuzi Yuci county was made the new Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he made Yuci county the seat of the new Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 優賞歸順將校，盡括僧道隸西京寺觀，官吏及高貲戶授田河南。

translations.literal: Surrendering officers were richly rewarded; monks and Daoists were all registered and assigned to temples and abbeys in the Western Capital; officials and wealthy households were granted land in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He lavished rewards on defecting commanders, registered every monk and priest to monasteries in Luoyang, and allotted Henan fields to officials and wealthy families.

sentences.zh: 北漢節度使蔚進盧遂以汾州降。

translations.literal: Northern Han military commissioner Wei Jinlu thereupon surrendered Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Han commissioner Wei Jinlu then surrendered Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以繼元為右衛上將軍、彭城郡公。

translations.literal: On jichou Jiyuan was made Right Guard general-in-chief and Duke of Pengcheng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he named Jiyuan general-in-chief of the Right Guard and Duke of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 帝作平晉詩，令從臣和。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a poem on the pacification of Jin and ordered his attending ministers to compose matching verses.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote a poem celebrating the conquest of Jin and bade his court poets answer in kind.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，繼元獻官妓百餘，以賜將校。

translations.literal: On xinmao Jiyuan presented more than a hundred palace entertainers, who were bestowed on the commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Jiyuan offered more than a hundred court musicians, and the emperor gave them to his generals.

sentences.zh: 乙未，築新城。

translations.literal: On yiwei a new city was built.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei work began on a new walled city.

sentences.zh: 送劉繼元緦麻以上親赴闕。

translations.literal: Jiyuan's relatives in three-year mourning and above were sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Jiyuan's kin in the deepest mourning grades to the court.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸城北，御沙河門樓。

translations.literal: On bingshen he visited the north of the city and mounted the tower at Shamen on the Sha River.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he rode to the northern quarter and took the tower over the Sha River gate.

sentences.zh: 盡徙餘民于新城，遣使督之，既出，即命縱火。

translations.literal: All remaining commoners were moved to the new city; envoys were sent to supervise them, and once they had gone out he ordered fire set.
translations.idiomatic: The last inhabitants were marched into the new town under overseers; when the old quarters stood empty he had them burned.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以行宮為平晉寺，帝作平晉記刻寺中。

translations.literal: On dingyou the field palace was made the Pacification-of-Jin Temple, and the Emperor's record of the pacification of Jin was carved in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he turned the campaign palace into the Pacification-of-Jin Temple and had his account of the conquest cut into stone there.

sentences.zh: 廢隆州，隳其城。

translations.literal: Long prefecture was abolished and its walls demolished.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished Longzhou and razed its fortifications.

sentences.zh: 庚子，發太原。

translations.literal: On gengzi he departed Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he marched out of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，次鎮州。

translations.literal: On dingwei he halted at Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he encamped at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，以將伐幽薊，遣發京東、河北諸州軍儲赴北面行營。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiayin, because he was about to attack You and Ji, he dispatched the mobilization of military stores from the various prefectures of Jingdong and Hebei to the northern field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the sixth month, preparing to strike Youzhou and Jizhou, he ordered Jingdong and Hebei prefectures to forward grain and arms to the northern headquarters.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝復自將伐契丹。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Emperor again personally led a campaign against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he took the field in person against the Khitan once more.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次金臺頓，募民為鄉導者百人。

translations.literal: On bingyin he halted at the Jintai post station and recruited a hundred commoners as local guides.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he paused at Jintai and enlisted a hundred local men as guides.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，次東易州，刺史劉宇以城降，留兵千人守之。

translations.literal: On dingmao he halted at East Yizhou; prefect Liu Yu surrendered the city, and a thousand troops were left to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he reached East Yizhou, where prefect Liu Yu opened the gates; he left a thousand men to hold the town.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，次涿州，判官劉厚德以城降。

translations.literal: On wuchen he halted at Zhuo prefecture; vice prefect Liu Houde surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhuozhou fell when vice prefect Liu Houde surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己巳，次鹽溝頓，民得近界馬來獻，賜以束帛。

translations.literal: On jisi he halted at the Yangou post station; commoners who had obtained horses from the near border came to present them and were rewarded with bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi at Yangou, villagers who had acquired horses along the frontier brought them in tribute and received silk in return.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次幽州城南，駐蹕寶光寺。

translations.literal: On gengwu he halted south of Youzhou city and encamped at Baoguang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he pitched camp south of Youzhou at Baoguang Temple.

sentences.zh: 契丹軍城北，帝率眾擊走之。

translations.literal: The Khitan army was north of the city; the Emperor led the host and struck, driving them off.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan forces held the north wall; the emperor led a charge and swept them from the field.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命節度使定國宋偓、河陽崔彥進、彰信劉遇、定武孟玄喆四面分兵攻城。

translations.literal: On renshen he ordered the military commissioners Song Wo of Dingguo, Cui Yanjin of Heyang, Liu Yu of Zhangxin, and Meng Xuanzhe of Dingwu to divide their forces on four sides and attack the city.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he sent commissioners Song Wo, Cui Yanjin, Liu Yu, and Meng Xuanzhe to assault Youzhou from four quarters.

sentences.zh: 以潘美知幽州行府事。

translations.literal: Pan Mei was made to administer the affairs of the Youzhou field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He placed Pan Mei in charge of the Youzhou field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 契丹鐵林廂主李札盧存以所部來降。

translations.literal: The Khitan Iron Forest bureau chief Li Zhailu surrendered with his command.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan Iron Forest commander Li Zhailu came over with his entire command.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，移幸城北，督諸將進兵，獲馬三百。

translations.literal: On guiyou he moved his camp to the north of the city, supervised the generals in advancing troops, and captured three hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he shifted north of the walls, drove the assault forward, and took three hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 幽州神武廳直并鄉兵四百人來降。

translations.literal: Four hundred Youzhou Shenwu hall guards together with militia came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred Shenwu guards and local militia from Youzhou defected.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，范陽民以牛酒犒師。

translations.literal: On yihai the people of Fanyang brought oxen and wine to cheer the army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Fanyang townsfolk brought oxen and wine to feast the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝乘輦督攻城。

translations.literal: On dingchou the Emperor rode in the palanquin to supervise the siege.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he went out in the imperial carriage to direct the siege himself.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，契丹建雄軍節度使、知順州劉廷素來降。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengchen, the Khitan Jianxiong Army military commissioner and Shunzhou administrator Liu Tingsu came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengchen, Khitan commissioner Liu Tingsu of Jianxiong Army, who also held Shunzhou, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬午，知薊州劉守恩來降。

translations.literal: On renwu the Jizhou administrator Liu Shou'en came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Jizhou prefect Liu Shou'en came over.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝督諸軍及契丹大戰于高梁河，敗績。

translations.literal: On guimo the Emperor supervised the armies in a great battle with the Khitan at Gaoliang River and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guimo he led the armies against the Khitan at Gaoliang River and suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 甲申，班師。

translations.literal: On jiashen the armies withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he ordered the retreat.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命孟玄喆屯定州，崔彥進屯關南。

translations.literal: On gengyin he ordered Meng Xuanzhe to garrison Ding prefecture and Cui Yanjin to garrison Guannan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he posted Meng Xuanzhe at Dingzhou and Cui Yanjin on the Guannan line.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，帝至自范陽。

translations.literal: On yisi the Emperor returned from Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he came back from the Fanyang campaign.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，西京留守石守信坐從征失律，貶崇信軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renzi, Western Capital defender Shi Shouxin, for misconduct on the campaign, was demoted to Chongxin Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi, he demoted Western Capital defender Shi Shouxin to commissioner of Chongxin Army for dereliction on campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，彰信軍節度使劉遇貶宿州觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiayin Zhangxin Army military commissioner Liu Yu was demoted to Suzhou observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he stripped Zhangxin commissioner Liu Yu of his command and made him Suzhou observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命潘美屯河東三交口。

translations.literal: On guihai he ordered Pan Mei to garrison the Sankou crossing in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he stationed Pan Mei at the Sankou crossing in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，汴水決宋城縣。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Bian Canal burst its banks at Songcheng county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Bian Canal broke through at Songcheng.

sentences.zh: 武功郡王德昭自殺。

translations.literal: Prince of Wugong commandery Dezhao committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Dezhao, Prince of Wugong, took his own life.

sentences.zh: 詔作太清樓。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the building of the Great Clarity Tower.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed construction of the Great Clarity Tower.

sentences.zh: 是月，秦州大水。

translations.literal: That month Qin prefecture suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods devastated Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，河決汲縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jimao, the Yellow River burst its banks at Ji county.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao, the Yellow River broke through at Jixian.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，置皇子侍讀。

translations.literal: On dinghai posts of tutors to the imperial sons were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he created the office of tutors to the princes.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸新城，觀鐵林軍人射強弩。

translations.literal: On jihai he visited the new city and watched Iron Forest troops shoot powerful crossbows.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he toured the new city to watch Iron Forest archers loose heavy crossbows.

sentences.zh: 庚子，華山道士丁少微詣闕，獻金丹及巨勝、南芝、玄芝。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Huashan Daoist Ding Shaowei came to court and presented elixir pills, jusheng, southern lingzhi, and dark lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Huashan recluse Ding Shaowei arrived at court with elixir pills and rare fungi—jusheng, southern lingzhi, and dark lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，山後兩林蠻以名馬來獻。

translations.literal: On guimao the Two-Lin barbarians beyond the mountains presented fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Two-Lin tribes of the northern hills sent prized horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鎮州都鈐轄劉廷翰及契丹戰于遂城西，大敗之，斬首萬三百級，獲三將、馬萬匹。

translations.literal: On bingwu Zhen prefecture chief inspector Liu Tinghan fought the Khitan west of Suicheng, greatly defeated them, and took ten thousand three hundred heads, three generals, and ten thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Liu Tinghan of Zhenzhou routed the Khitan west of Suicheng, claiming 10,300 heads, three generals, and ten thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，以平北漢功，齊王廷美進封秦王，薛居正加司空，沈倫加左僕射，盧多遜兼兵部尚書，曹彬兼侍中，白進超、崔翰、劉廷翰、田重進、米信並領諸軍節度使，楚昭輔、崔彥進、李漢瓊並加檢校太尉，潘美加檢校太師，王仁贍加檢校太傅，石熙載加刑部侍郎，文武從臣進秩有差。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on yihai, for the merit of pacifying Northern Han, Prince of Qi Tingmei was advanced to Prince of Qin; Xue Juzheng was made Sikong; Shen Lun was made Left Censor-in-chief; Lu Duosun was made concurrent Minister of War; Cao Bin was made concurrent Palace Attendant; Bai Jinchao, Cui Han, Liu Tinghan, Tian Chongjin, and Mi Xin were all made military commissioners of various armies; Chu Zhaofu, Cui Yanjin, and Li Hanqiong were all made honorary grandees; Pan Mei was made honorary grand mentor; Wang Renzan was made honorary grand tutor; Shi Xizai was made Vice Minister of Justice; civil and military followers were advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the tenth winter month he rewarded the fall of Northern Han: Tingmei rose from Prince of Qi to Prince of Qin; Xue Juzheng became Sikong; Shen Lun, left censor-in-chief; Lu Duosun took the war ministry with his council seat; Cao Bin, palace attendant; Bai Jinchao, Cui Han, Liu Tinghan, Tian Chongjin, and Mi Xin each received a circuit commission; Chu Zhaofu, Cui Yanjin, and Li Hanqiong became honorary grandees; Pan Mei, honorary grand mentor; Wang Renzan, honorary grand tutor; Shi Xizai, vice minister of justice; lesser civil and military followers were promoted by gradation.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，放道士丁少微歸華山。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, the Daoist Ding Shaowei was released to return to Huashan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, he sent the Daoist Ding Shaowei back to Huashan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On jichou he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he hunted outside the capital walls.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，忻州言與契丹戰，破之。

translations.literal: On xinmao Xin prefecture reported fighting the Khitan and defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Xinzhou reported a victory over Khitan raiders.

sentences.zh: 關南言破契丹，斬首萬餘級。

translations.literal: Guannan reported defeating the Khitan and taking more than ten thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: The Guannan garrison claimed a Khitan rout with more than ten thousand heads taken.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，占城國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingwei, Champa sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingwei, Champa dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On dingmao he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he hunted again near the capital.

sentences.zh: 置諸州司理判官。

translations.literal: Judicial-assistant posts were established in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He created judicial-assistant posts in every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月庚辰，詔宣慰河東諸州。

translations.literal: In year five, spring, first month, on gengchen, an edict ordered consolation of the various prefectures of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In year five, on gengchen in the first month of spring, he decreed relief missions to the Hedong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬午，新作天駟左、右監，以左、右飛龍使為左、右天廄使，閑廄使為崇儀使。

translations.literal: On renwu the new Left and Right Celestial Steed Directorates were built; the Left and Right Flying Dragon commissioners were made Left and Right Celestial Steed commissioners, and the Stud Farm commissioner was made Chongyi commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he founded the Left and Right Celestial Steed Directorates, renamed the Flying Dragon commissioners celestial steed commissioners, and the stud-farm commissioner the Chongyi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，改端明殿學士為文明殿學士。

translations.literal: On gengyin Duanming Hall academicians were renamed Civilization Hall academicians.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he retitled Duanming Hall academicians Civilization Hall academicians.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，斬徐州妖賊李緒等七人。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuchen, the Xuzhou sorcerer-rebel Li Xu and six others were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen, he executed Li Xu of Xuzhou and six fellow sorcerer-rebels.

sentences.zh: 廢順化軍。

translations.literal: Shunhua Army was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished Shunhua Army.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，會親王、宰相、淮海國王及從臣蹴鞠大明殿。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuzi, imperial princes, chief councilors, the king of Huaihai, and attending ministers kicked the ball in the Great Brightness Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the third month princes, chief ministers, the Huaihai king, and the court played cuju in the Great Brightness Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，左監門衛上將軍劉鋹卒，追封南越王。

translations.literal: On jichou Left Guard general-in-chief Liu Chang died and was posthumously enfeoffed as king of Southern Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the former Southern Han ruler Liu Chang died and was posthumously enfeoffed king of Southern Yue.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，代州言，宣徽南院使潘美敗契丹之師於雁門，殺其駙馬侍中蕭咄李，獲都指揮使李重誨。

translations.literal: On guisi the Southern Xuanhui Court commissioner Pan Mei defeated the Khitan army at Wild Goose Gate, killed their imperial son-in-law and palace attendant Xiao Duoli, and captured chief commander Li Chonghui.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Pan Mei of the Southern Xuanhui Court routed the Khitan at Wild Goose Gate, killed the imperial son-in-law Xiao Duoli, and took chief commander Li Chonghui.

sentences.zh: 閏三月丙午，幸水磑，因觀魚。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month, on bingwu, he visited the water mill and thereupon viewed fish.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, on bingwu, he went to the water mill and watched the fish.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，親試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: On jiayin he personally examined the Ministry of Rites candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he presided in person over the Ministry of Rites examinations.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，親試諸科舉人。

translations.literal: On dingsi he personally examined the candidates of the various examination categories.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he personally tested candidates in the specialized examination tracks.
