sentences.zh: 庚午，幸講武池觀習樓船。

translations.literal: On gengwu he visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Pool to observe practice with tower ships.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he went to the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Pool to watch tower-ship drills.

sentences.zh: 辛未，甘、沙州回鶻遣使以橐駝名馬來獻。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Gan and Shazhou Uighurs sent envoys presenting camels and fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei envoys from the Gan and Shazhou Uighurs arrived with camels and fine horses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，親試應百篇舉趙昌國，賜及第。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guimo, he personally examined Zhao Changguo, candidate in the Hundred-Chapter examination, and bestowed jinshi rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guimo, he personally tested Zhao Changguo in the Hundred-Chapter examination and awarded him the jinshi degree.

sentences.zh: 壅汾河晉祠水灌太原，隳其故城。

translations.literal: The Fen River and the Jin Shrine stream were dammed to flood Taiyuan and demolish its old walls.
translations.idiomatic: Engineers diverted the Fen and the Jin Shrine stream to inundate Taiyuan and tear down the old fortifications.

sentences.zh: 是月，壽州風雹，冠氏縣雨雹。

translations.literal: That month Shou prefecture suffered wind and hail, and Guanshi county hail.
translations.idiomatic: That month hailstorms struck Shouzhou and Guanshi county.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯朔，大霖雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the guimao new moon, great prolonged rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon in the fifth month torrential rains set in.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命宰相祈晴。

translations.literal: On xinyou he ordered the chief councilors to pray for clear weather.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he charged his chief ministers to pray for fair skies.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，高麗國王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renwu, the king of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 是月，潁州大水，徐州白溝溢入城。

translations.literal: That month Ying prefecture suffered great flood, and the White Ditch at Xuzhou overflowed into the city.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods hit Yingzhou, and at Xuzhou the White Ditch poured into the city.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，討交州黎桓，命蘭州團練使孫全興、八作使張濬、左監門衛將軍崔亮、寧州刺史劉澄、軍器庫副使賈湜、閣門祗候王僎並為部署。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingwei, Jiaozhou's Li Huan was attacked; Lanzhou training commissioner Sun Quanxing, Works commissioner Zhang Jun, Left Guard general Cui Liang, Ningzhou prefect Liu Cheng, Armory deputy commissioner Jia Shen, and Gate Attendant Wang Zhen were all made campaign commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingwei, he opened a campaign against Li Huan of Jiaozhou, naming Sun Quanxing, Zhang Jun, Cui Liang, Liu Cheng, Jia Shen, and Wang Zhen as expedition commanders.

sentences.zh: 全興、濬、亮由邕州，澄、湜、僎由廉州，各以其眾致討。

translations.literal: Quanxing, Jun, and Liang were to go by Yongzhou; Cheng, Shen, and Zhen by Lianzhou—each with his force to carry out the attack.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Quanxing, Zhang Jun, and Cui Liang marched from Yongzhou; Liu Cheng, Jia Shen, and Wang Zhen from Lianzhou—each column to strike by its own route.

sentences.zh: 庚申，北海虸蚄生。

translations.literal: On gengshen mayflies were born in the northern sea.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen mayflies swarmed along the northern coast—an omen of flood.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，西南蕃主龍瓊琚使其子羅若從並諸州蠻來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiashen, the southwestern tribal chief Long Qiongjun sent his son Luoruocong together with chieftains of various prefectures to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, southwestern chief Long Qiongjun sent his son Luoruocong and allied chieftains with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，黎桓遣使為丁璿上表求襲位。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guimao, Li Huan sent envoys to submit a memorial on behalf of Ding Xuan requesting succession to his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, Li Huan petitioned on behalf of Ding Xuan for recognition as Jiaozhi's rightful ruler.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，史館上太祖實錄。

translations.literal: On jiachen the History Office presented the Veritable Record of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the History Office submitted the Veritable Record of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On renxu he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，大發兵屯關南及鎮、定州。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuyin, great forces were mobilized to garrison Guannan and Zhen and Ding prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuyin, he massed troops on the Guannan line and at Zhenzhou and Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，發京師至雄州民治道。

translations.literal: On jichou commoners from the capital to Xiong prefecture were mobilized to repair the roads.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he drafted civilians from the capital to Xiongzhou to repair the campaign roads.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命侍衛馬軍都指揮使米信護定州屯兵。

translations.literal: On jiawu he ordered Palace Horse Army chief commander Mi Xin to command the Dingzhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he put Palace Horse Army commander Mi Xin in charge of the Dingzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子朔，安南靜海軍節度行軍司馬、權知州事丁璿上表求襲位，不報。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengzi new moon, Jinghai Army acting military affairs commissioner and acting prefect Ding Xuan submitted a memorial requesting succession to his post; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon in the eleventh month Ding Xuan of Jinghai Army petitioned to inherit his father's post; the court left the memorial unanswered.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以秦王廷美為東京留守，王仁贍為大內都部署，陳從信副之。

translations.literal: On bingwu Prince of Qin Tingmei was made Eastern Capital defender, Wang Renzan grand inner palace commissioner, and Chen Congxin his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he named Prince of Qin Tingmei Eastern Capital defender, with Wang Renzan as grand inner commissioner and Chen Congxin as deputy.

sentences.zh: 己酉，帝伐契丹。

translations.literal: On jiyou the Emperor campaigned against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he took the field against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，發京師。

translations.literal: On renzi he departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he marched out of the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，次長垣縣。

translations.literal: On guichou he halted at Changyuan county.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he encamped at Changyuan.

sentences.zh: 關南與契丹戰，大破之。

translations.literal: Guannan fought the Khitan and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Guannan garrison reported a major victory over the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 以河陽三城節度使崔彥進為關南都部署。

translations.literal: Heyang Three Cities military commissioner Cui Yanjin was made Guannan campaign commander.
translations.idiomatic: He named Heyang commissioner Cui Yanjin commander of the Guannan campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊午，駐蹕大名府。

translations.literal: On wuwu he encamped at Daming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he halted at Daming.

sentences.zh: 諸軍及契丹大戰于莫州，敗績。

translations.literal: The armies fought a great battle with the Khitan at Mo prefecture and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Song and Khitan armies clashed at Mozhou and the Song forces were routed.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，大閱，遂宴幄殿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, a grand review was held, and then a banquet in the Tent Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, he held a grand troop review and feasted the commanders in the Tent Hall.

sentences.zh: 衛士有盜獲麞者當坐，詔特釋之。

translations.literal: A guardsman who had stolen a roe deer was due for punishment; an edict specially released him.
translations.idiomatic: When a guardsman faced punishment for poaching a roe deer, the emperor pardoned him by special decree.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以保靜軍節度使劉遇、威塞軍節度使曹翰為幽州東、西路部署。

translations.literal: On wuyin Baojing Army military commissioner Liu Yu and Weisai Army military commissioner Cao Han were made eastern and western route commanders for Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he appointed Liu Yu of Baojing Army and Cao Han of Weisai Army eastern and western commanders for the Youzhou front.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，發大名府，因校獵。

translations.literal: On gengchen he departed Daming prefecture and thereupon held a hunting review.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he left Daming and held a hunting review on the march.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，帝至自大名府。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Emperor returned from Daming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he came back from Daming.

sentences.zh: 交州行營與賊戰，大破之。

translations.literal: The Jiaozhou field army fought the rebels and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaozhi expedition reported a crushing victory over the rebels.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸卯，置平塞、靜戎二軍。

translations.literal: In year six, spring, first month, on guimao, Pingsai and Jingrong armies were established.
translations.idiomatic: In year six, on guimao in the first month of spring, he created the Pingsai and Jingrong armies.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，易州破契丹數千眾。

translations.literal: On xinhai Yizhou defeated several thousand Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Yizhou reported routing several thousand Khitan raiders.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，改靜戎軍為安靜軍。

translations.literal: On bingyin Jingrong Army was renamed Anjing Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he renamed Jingrong Army the Anjing Army.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，命宰臣禱雨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jimao, he ordered the chief councilors to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jimao, he charged his chief ministers to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，興元尹德芳薨，追封岐王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiyou, Xingyuan metropolitan governor Defang died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiyou, Xingyuan governor Defang died and was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔令諸路轉運使察官吏賢否以聞。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict ordered the various circuit transport commissioners to investigate whether officials were worthy or unworthy and report.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he told transport commissioners in every circuit to report which local officials deserved praise or censure.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，置破虜、平戎二軍。

translations.literal: On bingchen Poluo and Pingrong armies were established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he founded the Poluo and Pingrong armies.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，高昌國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On dingsi the state of Gaochang sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Gaochang sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，交州行營破賊于白藤江口，獲戰艦二百艘，知邕州侯仁寶死之。

translations.literal: On renxu the Jiaozhou field army defeated the rebels at the mouth of the White Vine River, captured two hundred warships, and Yongzhou prefect Hou Renbao died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Jiaozhi expedition routed the enemy at White Vine River, seized two hundred warships, and lost Yongzhou prefect Hou Renbao.

sentences.zh: 會炎瘴，軍士多死者，轉運使許仲宣驛聞，詔班師。

translations.literal: Because of malarial vapors many soldiers died; transport commissioner Xu Zhongxuan reported by post-station relay, and an edict ordered withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: Heat and fever killed many men; Xu Zhongxuan relayed the news by courier, and the court ordered the army home.

sentences.zh: 詔斬劉澄、賈湜于軍中，徵孫全興下獄。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Liu Cheng and Jia Shen beheaded in the army, and Sun Quanxing summoned and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Liu Cheng and Jia Shen executed in camp and had Sun Quanxing arrested and thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 令諸州長吏五日一慮囚。

translations.literal: He ordered the chief officials of the various prefectures to review prisoners once every five days.
translations.idiomatic: He required prefectural magistrates to hear criminal cases every five days.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，幸太平興國寺禱雨。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinwei, he visited Everlasting Flourishing Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinwei, he went to Everlasting Flourishing Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，高麗國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu the king of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 禁西川諸州白衣巫師。

translations.literal: White-robed shamans in the various prefectures of western Sichuan were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He banned white-robed shamans throughout western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 罷湖州織羅，放女工。

translations.literal: Huzhou silk-weaving was abolished and the female workers released.
translations.idiomatic: He shut down Huzhou's imperial silk workshops and freed the women weavers.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiwei, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiwei, rain came at last.

sentences.zh: 降死罪囚，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Death-sentence prisoners were reduced in punishment; those in exile and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: He commuted death sentences and freed everyone sentenced to exile or below.

sentences.zh: 平塞軍與契丹戰，破之。

translations.literal: Pingsai Army fought the Khitan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Pingsai Army reported a victory over the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，司空、平章事薛居正薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Sikong and Chief Councilor Xue Juzheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Sikong and chief councilor Xue Juzheng died.

sentences.zh: 七月丙午，詔渤海琰府王助討契丹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on bingwu, an edict ordered the Bohai Yanfu king to assist in attacking the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingwu, he ordered the Bohai Yanfu king to join the campaign against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 是月，延州、鄜、寧、河中大水，宋州蝗。

translations.literal: That month Yan, Bin, Ning, and Hezhong suffered great flood; Song prefecture locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods struck Yanzhou, Binzhou, Ningzhou, and Hezhong, and locusts ravaged Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the yimao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon in the ninth month a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，左拾遺田錫上疏極諫，詔嘉獎之。

translations.literal: On jiachen Left Reminder Tian Xi submitted a memorial of stern remonstrance; an edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen remonstrance official Tian Xi submitted a fierce memorial of counsel; the emperor praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 丙午，置京朝官差遣院，初令中書舍人郭贄等考校課績。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Court Assignment Office for Capital Officials was established; at first Secretariat Drafter Guo Zan and others were ordered to examine performance records.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he founded the Court Assignment Office and set Guo Zan and other secretariat drafters to grade capital officials' performance.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以趙普為司徒，石熙載為樞密使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Zhao Pu was made Minister of Works and Shi Xizai Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he restored Zhao Pu as Minister of Works and named Shi Xizai military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔求直言。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict sought forthright speech.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he issued an edict inviting blunt counsel from the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，易州言破契丹。

translations.literal: On bingchen Yizhou reported defeating the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yizhou reported a victory over Khitan forces.

sentences.zh: 斬緜州妖賊王禧等十人。

translations.literal: The Mian prefecture sorcerer-rebel Wang Xi and ten others were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He beheaded Wang Xi of Mianzhou and ten fellow sorcerer-rebels.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，群臣三奉表上尊號曰應運統天睿文英武大聖至明廣孝皇帝，許之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guiyou, the hundred officials thrice submitted memorials offering the honorific title Responsive-to-Fate, Unifying Heaven, Sagely in Text, Heroic in Martial Affairs, Greatly Sagely, Utterly Bright, Broadly Filial Emperor; he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the tenth winter month the court thrice petitioned to style him Responsive-to-Fate, Unifying Heaven, Sagely in Text, Heroic in Martial Affairs, Greatly Sagely, Utterly Bright, Broadly Filial Emperor—and he accepted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以河陽三城節度使崔彥進為關南都部署，侍衛馬軍都指揮使米信為定州都部署。

translations.literal: On jiashen Heyang Three Cities military commissioner Cui Yanjin was made Guannan campaign commander, and Palace Horse Army chief commander Mi Xin was made Dingzhou campaign commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he reappointed Cui Yanjin commander of Guannan and Mi Xin commander at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，校歷代醫書。

translations.literal: On bingxu medical books of successive dynasties were collated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the court began collating medical texts from past dynasties.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔作蘇州太一宮成。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict announced the completion of the Great Unity Palace at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he proclaimed the Great Unity Palace at Suzhou finished.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，監察御史張白坐知蔡州日假官錢糴糶，棄市。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingyou, investigating censor Zhang Bai, for borrowing official funds to buy and sell grain while knowing Cai prefecture, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingyou, censor Zhang Bai was put to death in the market for using public funds to speculate in grain while prefect of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，改武德司為皇城司。

translations.literal: On jiachen the Martial Virtue Office was renamed the Imperial City Office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he renamed the Martial Virtue Office the Imperial City Office.

sentences.zh: 女真遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Jurchen sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen envoys arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinhai he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound and declared a grand amnesty.

sentences.zh: 御乾元殿受尊號，內外文武加恩。

translations.literal: He received the honorific at the Hall of Qianyuan; civil and military officials within and without were granted favor.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of Qianyuan he received the new title and extended favors to officials throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 壬子，令諸州監臨官有所聞見傳聞須面陳者，俟報。

translations.literal: On renzi he ordered that supervisory officials in the various prefectures who had matters heard or rumored that required face-to-face report should await reply.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he ruled that circuit inspectors who learned of urgent matters must report in person and await imperial response.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，交州行營部署孫全興棄市。

translations.literal: On dingsi Jiaozhou campaign commander Sun Quanxing was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he had Jiaozhi expedition commander Sun Quanxing executed in the market.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以樞密使楚昭輔為左驍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On xinyou Military Affairs Commissioner Chu Zhaofu was made Left Valiant Cavalry general-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he named military affairs commissioner Chu Zhaofu general-in-chief of the Left Valiant Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，購求醫書。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, medical books were sought by purchase.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, he offered rewards for medical books.

sentences.zh: 己卯，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On jimao he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 己丑，諸道節度州置觀察支使，奉料同掌書記，仍不得並置。

translations.literal: On jichou observation-assistant posts were established in circuit and prefectural military commissions; their stipend was the same as the registrar's, and the two posts could not be held concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he created observation-assistant posts in every circuit and prefectural command, paid like registrars and barred from holding both offices at once.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禁民私市近界部落馬。

translations.literal: On xinmao commoners were forbidden to buy horses privately from tribal peoples of the near border.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he outlawed private purchase of horses from frontier tribes along the border.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲午朔，不受朝，群臣詣閤稱賀。

translations.literal: In year seven, spring, first month, on the jiawu new moon, he did not receive audience; the hundred officials went to the gate to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In year seven, on the jiawu new moon in the first month of spring, he withheld throne audience while officials offered new-year greetings at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，定輿服等差及婚取喪葬儀制。

translations.literal: On renxu ranks of chariots, robes, and caps and the ritual for marriage, taking a wife, and mourning were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he codified ranks of transport, dress, and the rites of marriage, betrothal, and mourning.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，改關南為高陽關，徙并州治唐明鎮。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiashen, Guannan was renamed Gaoyang Pass, and the Bingzhou seat was moved to Tangming town.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen, he renamed Guannan Gaoyang Pass and moved the Bingzhou seat to Tangming.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，特貰廬州管內逋米萬七千二百四十石。

translations.literal: On yiyou a special pardon remitted thirty-seven thousand two hundred forty piculs of overdue grain within Luzhou circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he pardoned 37,240 piculs of back taxes owed within Luzhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the guisi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon in the third month a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以秦王廷美為西京留守。

translations.literal: On yiwei Prince of Qin Tingmei was made Western Capital defender.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he named Prince of Qin Tingmei Western Capital defender.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以旱分遣中黃門遍禱方岳。

translations.literal: On yisi, because of drought, inner yellow-gate attendants were dispatched everywhere to pray at the sacred mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, citing drought, he sent palace eunuchs to every sacred peak to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 交州以王師致討遣使來謝。

translations.literal: Jiaozhou, because the imperial army had come to attack, sent envoys to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi, chastened by the expedition, sent envoys to thank the throne.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜秦王襲衣、通犀帶、錢十萬。

translations.literal: On renzi he bestowed on the Prince of Qin court robes, a rhinoceros-horn belt, and one hundred thousand in money.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he gave the Prince of Qin ceremonial robes, a rhinoceros-horn belt, and 100,000 cash.

sentences.zh: 是月，舒州上玄石，有白文曰「丙子年出趙號二十一帝」。

translations.literal: That month Shuzhou presented a dark stone with white script reading, "In the bingzi year the Zhao house will produce twenty-one emperors."
translations.idiomatic: That month Shuzhou sent up a black stone marked in white: "In the bingzi year the House of Zhao will see twenty-one emperors."

sentences.zh: 宣州雪霜殺桑害稼。

translations.literal: Xuan prefecture frost and snow killed mulberry trees and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Frost and snow at Xuanzhou killed mulberries and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 北陽縣蝗，飛鳥數萬食之盡。

translations.literal: Beiyang county suffered locusts; tens of thousands of birds ate them to extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts swarmed Beiyang until flocks of birds devoured them clean.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，以樞密直學士竇偁、中書舍人郭贄並參知政事，如京使柴禹錫為宣徽北院使兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiazi, Secretariat Direct Academician Dou Cheng and Secretariat Drafter Guo Zan were both made participants in governance; Capital Envoy Chai Yuxi was made Northern Xuanhui Court commissioner concurrent with Military Affairs Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi, he named Dou Cheng and Guo Zan participants in governance and made capital envoy Chai Yuxi northern Xuanhui commissioner with a seat as vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，中書侍郎兼兵部尚書、平章事盧多遜罷為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On wuchen Secretariat Vice Director concurrent Minister of War and Chief Councilor Lu Duosun was dismissed and made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he removed Lu Duosun from the council and retained him only as minister of war.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，西京留守、秦王廷美罷歸第，復其子德恭、德隆名皇侄，女韓氏婦落皇女、雲陽公主之號。

translations.literal: On dingchou Western Capital defender Prince of Qin Tingmei was dismissed and returned to his residence; his sons Degong and Delong again bore the names imperial nephew; his daughter the Han clan wife was stripped of the titles imperial daughter and Princess of Cloudy Sun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he recalled Western Capital defender Tingmei to his mansion, demoted his sons Degong and Delong to the rank of imperial nephew, and stripped his daughter, wife of the Han clan, of her princess title.

sentences.zh: 盧多遜褫職流崖州，並徙其家，期周以上親悉配遠裔。

translations.literal: Lu Duosun was stripped of office and exiled to Yazhou; his household was also moved, and collateral kin of three-year mourning and above were all assigned to distant lands.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Duosun was disgraced and banished to Yazhou with his entire household; every cousin in the mourning grades was sent to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，左僕射、平章事沈倫罷為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On gengchen Left Censor-in-chief and Chief Councilor Shen Lun was dismissed and made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he removed Shen Lun from the council and made him minister of works.

sentences.zh: 禁河南諸州私鑄鉛錫惡錢及輕小錢。

translations.literal: In the various prefectures of Henan, private casting of lead-tin debased coins and lightweight coins was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He banned private minting of debased lead-tin and lightweight coins throughout Henan.

sentences.zh: 是月，潤州大水。

translations.literal: That month Run prefecture suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods inundated Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，崔彥進敗契丹於唐興。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinchou, Cui Yanjin defeated the Khitan at Tangxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinchou, Cui Yanjin routed the Khitan at Tangxing.

sentences.zh: 戊申，慮囚。

translations.literal: On wushen he reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 己酉，夏州留後李繼捧獻其銀、夏、綏、宥四州。

translations.literal: On jiyou Xiazhou acting prefect Li Jipin presented his four prefectures of Yin, Xia, Sui, and You.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Xiazhou regent Li Jipin surrendered Yin, Xia, Sui, and You prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，三交行營言，潘美敗契丹之師於鴈門，破其壘三十六。

translations.literal: On xinhai the Sanjiao field headquarters reported that Pan Mei defeated the Khitan army at Wild Goose Gate and destroyed thirty-six of their encampments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Sanjiao headquarters reported Pan Mei's victory at Wild Goose Gate and the destruction of thirty-six Khitan camps.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，秦王廷美降封涪陵縣公、房州安置。

translations.literal: On bingchen Prince of Qin Tingmei was demoted and enfeoffed as Duke of Fuling county, assigned to Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he demoted Prince of Qin Tingmei to Duke of Fuling and exiled him to Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以崇儀副使閻彥進知房州，監察御史袁廓通判軍州事，各賜白金三百兩。

translations.literal: Chongyi deputy commissioner Yan Yanjin was made to administer Fang prefecture, investigating censor Yuan Kuo was made military vice prefect, and each was granted three hundred taels of white gold.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yan Yanjin to govern Fangzhou, Yuan Kuo as military vice prefect, and gave each three hundred taels of white gold.

sentences.zh: 己未，府州破契丹於新澤砦，獲其將校以下百人。

translations.literal: On jiwei Fuzhou defeated the Khitan at the Xinze stockade and captured one hundred commanders and below.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Fuzhou routed the Khitan at Xinze stockade and took a hundred officers and men.

sentences.zh: 是月，陝州蝗，蕪湖縣雨雹。

translations.literal: That month Shaan prefecture locusts; Wuhu county hail.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts struck Shaanzhou and hail battered Wuhu county.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，遣使發李繼捧緦麻以上親赴闕，其弟繼遷奔地斤澤。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yihai, envoys were dispatched to send Li Jipin's relatives in three-year mourning and above to the capital; his younger brother Jiqian fled to Dijin Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the sixth month he summoned Li Jipin's kin in the deepest mourning grades to court while Jipin's brother Jiqian fled to Dijin Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丙子，置譯經院。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Scripture Translation Institute was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he founded the Scripture Translation Institute.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決臨濟縣，漢陽軍大水。

translations.literal: That month the Yellow River burst at Linji county; Hanyang Army suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River broke through at Linji and floods overwhelmed Hanyang Army.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，以子德崇為檢校太傅、同平章事，封衛王；

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiawu, his son Dezong was made honorary Grand Tutor and Associate Chief Councilor and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiawu, he named his son Dezong honorary grand tutor, associate chief councilor, and Prince of Wei;

sentences.zh: 德明為檢校太保、同平章事，封廣平郡王。

translations.literal: Deming was made honorary Grand Guardian and Associate Chief Councilor and enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: and Deming honorary grand guardian, associate chief councilor, and Prince of Guangping.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，工部尚書沈倫以左僕射致仕。

translations.literal: On yimao Minister of Works Shen Lun retired on the post of Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Minister of Works Shen Lun retired with the rank of left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決范濟口，淮水、漢水、易水皆溢，陽穀縣蝗，關、陝諸州大水。

translations.literal: That month the Yellow River burst at Fanji crossing; the Huai, Han, and Yi rivers all overflowed; Yanggu county locusts; Guan and Shan circuits great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River broke at Fanji; the Huai, Han, and Yi flooded; locusts hit Yanggu; and floods ravaged Guan and Shan circuits.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申朔，太子太師王溥薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the gengshen new moon, Grand Preceptor Wang Pu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon in the eighth month Grand Preceptor Wang Pu died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔川峽諸州官織錦綺、鹿胎、透背、六銖、欹正、龜殼等悉罷之，民間勿禁。

translations.literal: On jimao an edict ordered that in the various prefectures of the Sichuan gorges official weaving of brocade, deer-fetal, openwork, six-zhu, slanting-weave, and tortoise-shell silks all be abolished, and that among the people there be no prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he ended official brocade and specialty silks in the Sichuan gorges and lifted all bans on private weaving.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑朔，西京諸道係籍沙彌，令祠部給牒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jichou new moon, novice monks registered in the Western Capital and various circuits were ordered to receive certificates from the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon in the ninth month he required novice monks in Luoyang and every circuit to register with the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，貴妃孫氏薨。

translations.literal: On jiayin Honored Consort Sun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Honored Consort Sun died.

sentences.zh: 邠州蝗。

translations.literal: Bin prefecture locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts swarmed Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，詔：河南吏民不得闌出邊關侵撓略奪，違者論罪，有得羊馬生口者還之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guihai, an edict stated: officials and commoners of Henan must not cross the border passes to raid, plunder, or seize; violators will be punished according to law, and any sheep, horses, or captives taken must be returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the tenth winter month he decreed that Henan officials and civilians must not cross the frontier to raid or seize booty—violators would face the law, and any livestock or captives taken must be returned.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，幸金明池，御龍舟觀習水戰。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he visited Jinming Pool, boarded the dragon boat, and watched naval drills.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he went to Jinming Pool, took the imperial dragon boat, and reviewed the fleet in exercise.

sentences.zh: 河決武德縣，蠲臨河民租。

translations.literal: The Yellow River broke its banks at Wude county; rent for riverside commoners was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached at Wude, and the court canceled grain tax for families along the banks.

sentences.zh: 己卯，左諫議大夫、參知政事竇偁卒。

translations.literal: On jimao, Left Reminder and participant councilor Dou Cheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao chief councilor Dou Cheng, remonstrance official of the left, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，乾元曆成。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Qianyuan calendar was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the new Qianyuan calendar was finished.

sentences.zh: 是月，岳州田鼠食稼。

translations.literal: That month, field mice in Yue prefecture ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: That month rats ravaged the Yuezhou harvest.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，以李繼捧為彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, Li Jibeng was made Military Commissioner of Zhangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, he named Li Jibeng commissioner of Zhangde Army.

sentences.zh: 禁民喪葬作樂。

translations.literal: Funeral music at commoners' burials was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He banned musical performances at civilian funerals.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, the new-moon day, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon in the twelfth month a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 庚午，蠲兩浙諸州太平興國六年以前逋租。

translations.literal: On gengwu, overdue rent before Taiping Xingguo year six in the Two Zhe prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he wrote off back taxes owed from before Taiping Xingguo year six across the Two Zhes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，高麗國王伷卒，其弟治遣使求襲位，詔立治為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Goryeo's King Zhu died; his younger brother Zhi sent envoys to request succession, and an edict installed Zhi as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin King Zhu of Goryeo died; his brother Zhi petitioned for the throne, and the court recognized Zhi as king.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子朔，豐州與契丹戰，破之，獲其天德軍節度使蕭太。

translations.literal: On the intercalary month's wuzi new moon, Feng prefecture fought the Khitan and defeated them, capturing their Tiande Army Military Commissioner Xiao Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month's wuzi new moon Fengzhou routed the Khitan and took their Tiande Army commissioner Xiao Tai prisoner.

sentences.zh: 占城國獻馴象。

translations.literal: Champa presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Champa sent trained elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙申，狩近郊。

translations.literal: On bingshen, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he hunted in the outskirts near the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔赦銀、夏等州常赦所不原者。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict pardoned those in Yin, Xia, and other prefectures whom ordinary amnesties did not cover.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he issued a special pardon for Yin, Xia, and neighboring circuits excluded from routine clemency.

sentences.zh: 諸州置農師。

translations.literal: Agricultural instructors were established in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Every prefecture received an official agricultural instructor.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月己卯，以東上閤門使王顯為宣徽南院使，酒坊使弭德超為北院使，並兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: In year eight, spring, first month, on jimao, East Upper Gate envoy Wang Xian was made Southern Bureau of Palace Attendants commissioner, wine-workshop commissioner Mi Dechao Northern Bureau commissioner, both concurrently Vice Commissioners of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo year eight, on jimao in the first month of spring, he named Wang Xian southern palace attendant commissioner and Mi Dechao northern commissioner, each also a vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔令州、縣長吏延問高年耆德。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to call on the aged and virtuous.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he decreed that local magistrates must visit and consult elderly men of merit.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuzi, the new-moon day, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon in the second month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禁內屬部落私市女口。

translations.literal: On dingyou, dependent tribes within the borders were forbidden to trade in women privately.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he outlawed private sale of women among affiliated border peoples.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，以右諫議大夫宋琪為參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengshen, Right Reminder Song Qi was made participant in governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, he appointed Right Reminder Song Qi chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 豐州破契丹兵，降三千餘帳。

translations.literal: Feng prefecture defeated Khitan troops and accepted the surrender of more than three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Fengzhou broke the Khitan army and took the submission of over three thousand tents.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，分三司，各置使。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Three Departments were divided, each given its own commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he split the Three Departments of finance and placed a commissioner over each.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸金明池，觀習水戰。

translations.literal: On guiyou, he visited Jinming Pool and watched naval drills.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he returned to Jinming Pool for another fleet review.

sentences.zh: 丙子，親試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he personally examined the Ministry of Rites candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he held the palace examination for Ministry of Rites graduates himself.

sentences.zh: 甲申，除福建諸州鹽禁。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the salt monopoly in Fujian prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he lifted the salt ban across Fujian.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，班外官戒諭辭。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renyin, the admonitory address for outer-service officials was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, he published the charge of office read to newly appointed field officials.

sentences.zh: 壬子，流樞密副使弭德超於瓊州，并徙其家。

translations.literal: On renzi, Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Mi Dechao was exiled to Qiong prefecture, and his household was moved as well.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Mi Dechao was banished to Qiongzhou and his family relocated with him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸樞密使石熙載第視疾。

translations.literal: On yimao, he visited Military Affairs Commissioner Shi Xizai's residence to see him in illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he called at Shi Xizai's home to inquire after the bureau director's health.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，詔作太一宮於都城南。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingmao, an edict ordered construction of the Taiyi Palace south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingmao, he decreed a Taiyi Palace south of the city wall.

sentences.zh: 黎桓自稱三使留後，遣使來貢，并上丁璿讓表。

translations.literal: Le Huan styled himself Acting Commissioner of the Three Agencies, sent envoys with tribute, and submitted Ding Xuan's letter of abdication.
translations.idiomatic: Le Huan of Annam called himself acting chief of the three agencies, sent tribute, and forwarded Ding Xuan's abdication petition.

sentences.zh: 詔諭桓送璿母子赴闕，不聽。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Huan to send Xuan and his mother to court; he did not obey.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Huan to deliver Ding Xuan and his mother to the capital; he refused.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，流威塞軍節度使曹翰于登州。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Military Commissioner of Weisai Army Cao Han was exiled to Deng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Cao Han, commissioner of Weisai Army, was banished to Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔長吏誘致關、隴流亡。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict ordered chief officials to induce refugees of Guan and Long to return.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he told local magistrates to entice exiles from Guan and Long back to their fields.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決滑州，過澶、濮、曹、濟，東南入于淮。

translations.literal: That month, the river broke at Hua prefecture, passed through Chan, Pu, Cao, and Ji, and flowed southeast into the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River burst at Huazhou, cut through Chan, Pu, Cao, and Ji, and poured southeast into the Huai.

sentences.zh: 相州風雹。

translations.literal: Xiang prefecture suffered wind and hail.
translations.idiomatic: A hailstorm struck Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，以王顯為樞密使，柴禹錫為宣徵南院使兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jihai, Wang Xian was made Commissioner of Military Affairs, and Chai Yuxi Southern Bureau of Palace Attendants commissioner concurrently Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai, he promoted Wang Xian to bureau director and named Chai Yuxi southern palace attendant commissioner and vice director.

sentences.zh: 己酉，兗州泰山父老及瑕丘等七縣民詣闕請封禪。

translations.literal: On jiyou, elders of Mount Tai in Yan prefecture and people of Xiaqiu and six other counties came to court requesting the feng and shan sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou elders from Taishan in Yanzhou and seven counties including Xiaqiu petitioned at court for an imperial fengshan on Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 是月，穀、洛、瀍、澗溢，壞官民舍萬餘區，溺死者以萬計，鞏縣壞殆盡。

translations.literal: That month the Gu, Luo, Chan, and Jian rivers overflowed, destroying more than ten thousand government and private dwellings; those drowned numbered in the tens of thousands, and Gong county was nearly wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods on the Gu, Luo, Chan, and Jian rivers wrecked over ten thousand homes and drowned tens of thousands; Gong county all but vanished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，參知政事郭贄罷為秘書少監。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinwei, participant councilor Guo Zan was dismissed and made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinwei, chief councilor Guo Zan was demoted to vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，加宋琪刑部尚書，以工部尚書李昉參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Song Qi was promoted to Minister of Punishments; Minister of Works Li Fang was made participant in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Song Qi rose to minister of punishments and Li Fang, minister of works, joined the chief council.

sentences.zh: 是月，河、江、漢、滹沱及祁之資、滄之胡盧、雄之易惡池水皆溢為患。

translations.literal: That month the Yellow River, Yangtze, Han, Hutuo, and the Zi in Qi, Hulu in Cang, and the Yi'e Pool in Xiong all overflowed and brought disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River, Yangtze, Han, Hutuo, the Zi at Qi, Hulu at Cang, and Xiong's Yi'e Pool all flooded and wrought havoc.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，以大水故，釋死罪以下。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renchen, because of the great floods, those guilty of capital crimes and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen, citing the catastrophic floods, he granted amnesty up through capital offenses.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，山後兩林蠻來貢。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Two Lin tribes from behind the mountains came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Two Lin peoples of the northern ranges presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 溪、錦、敘、富四州蠻來附。

translations.literal: The Yi, Jin, Xu, and Fu prefecture tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tribes of Xi, Jin, Xu, and Fu prefectures came over to the court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以樞密使石熙載為右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Military Affairs Commissioner Shi Xizai was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he named bureau director Shi Xizai right vice director of the Department of State.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，增諡法。

translations.literal: On xinhai, posthumous-title regulations were expanded.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he broadened the code governing imperial posthumous names.

sentences.zh: 詔：軍國政要令參知政事李昉及樞密院副使一人錄送史館。

translations.literal: An edict stated: important military and state affairs were to be recorded by participant councilor Li Fang and one vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and sent to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that Li Fang and one vice director of Military Affairs must log major state and military decisions for the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑朔，占城國獻馴象。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou, the new-moon day, Champa presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon in the ninth month Champa again sent trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 初置水陸路發運于京師。

translations.literal: For the first time a water-and-land transport commission was established at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The court founded its first capital office for combined river and road grain transport.

sentences.zh: 是月，睢溢，浸田六十里。

translations.literal: That month the Sui River overflowed and flooded fields for sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Sui River burst its banks and drowned cropland for twenty miles.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，改衛王德崇名元佐，廣平郡王德明名元祐，德昌名元休，德嚴名元雋，德和名元傑。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuxu, Prince Wei Degong's name was changed to Yuanzuo, Guangping Prince Deming to Yuanyou, Dechang to Yuanxiu, Deyan to Yuanjuan, and Dehe to Yuanjie.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuxu, he renamed Prince Wei Degong Yuanzuo, Guangping Prince Deming Yuanyou, Dechang Yuanxiu, Deyan Yuanjuan, and Dehe Yuanjie.

sentences.zh: 已酉，進元佐為楚王、元祐陳王，封元休韓王、元雋冀王、元傑益王，並檢校太保、同平章事。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Yuanzuo was advanced to Prince of Chu and Yuanyou Prince of Chen; Yuanxiu was enfeoffed Prince of Han, Yuanjuan Prince of Ji, and Yuanjie Prince of Yi, all made honorary Grand Guardian and Co-equal Prime Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Yuanzuo became Prince of Chu and Yuanyou Prince of Chen; Yuanxiu received Han, Yuanjuan Ji, and Yuanjie Yi, each with honorary grand guardian and co-equal prime minister titles.

sentences.zh: 司徒、兼侍中趙普罷為武勝軍節度使。

translations.literal: Grand Mentor and concurrent Palace Attendant Zhao Pu was dismissed and made Military Commissioner of Wusheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Pu, grand mentor and palace attendant, left the capital council for the Wusheng Army commission.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子朔，以參知政事宋琪、李昉並平章事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi, the new-moon day, participant councilors Song Qi and Li Fang were both made Co-equal Prime Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon in the eleventh month Song Qi and Li Fang were both promoted to full chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，除川峽民祖父母父母在別籍異財棄市律。

translations.literal: On guichou, the law of capital punishment for Sichuan-gorge commoners who kept grandparents or parents on a separate household register with separate property was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he repealed the Sichuan statute that made separate registers and estates while parents or grandparents lived a capital crime.

sentences.zh: 己未，太一宮成。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Taiyi Palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Taiyi Palace was finished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以翰林學士李穆、呂蒙正、李至並參知政事，樞密直學士張齊賢、王沔並同簽署樞密院事。

translations.literal: On renshen, Hanlin Academicians Li Mu, Lü Mengzheng, and Li Zhi were made participants in governance; Military Affairs Academicians Zhang Qixian and Wang Hong were made co-signatories of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he named Li Mu, Lü Mengzheng, and Li Zhi chief councilors and made Zhang Qixian and Wang Hong co-signatories at Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，置侍讀官。

translations.literal: On gengchen, lecturing attendants were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he created the office of lecturing attendant for the princes.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午朔，詔綏、銀、夏等州官吏招誘沒界外民歸業，仍給復三年。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renwu, the new-moon day, an edict ordered officials of Sui, Yin, Xia, and other prefectures to induce people beyond the border who had been lost to return to their fields, granting three years' tax relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon in the twelfth month he told Sui, Yin, and Xia officials to lure refugees back from beyond the line with three years without tax.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜河北、河東緣邊戍卒襦，京城諸軍米。

translations.literal: On dinghai, padded jackets were bestowed on garrison soldiers along the Hebei and Hedong frontiers, and grain on the capital armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he gave quilted coats to Hebei and Hedong border troops and issued grain to the capital garrisons.

sentences.zh: 淮海國王錢俶三上表乞解兵馬大元帥、國王、尚書中書令、太師等官。

translations.literal: King of Huaihai Qian Chu three times submitted memorials begging to be relieved of the posts of Grand Marshal, King, Director of the Secretariat, and Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Chu, king of Huaihai, thrice petitioned to resign as grand marshal, king, secretariat director, and grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 罷元帥名，餘不許。

translations.literal: The title of grand marshal was removed; the rest was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court stripped his grand marshal title but refused the other resignations.

sentences.zh: 西人寇宥州，巡檢使李詢擊走之。

translations.literal: Western tribes raided You prefecture; Patrol Commissioner Li Xun drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Tangut raiders struck Youzhou; patrol commissioner Li Xun beat them back.

sentences.zh: 是月，醴泉縣水中草變為稻。

translations.literal: That month, grass in the waters of Liquan county turned into rice.
translations.idiomatic: That month grass in Liquan's streams was said to have transformed into rice.

sentences.zh: 滑州河決。

translations.literal: The Yellow River broke its banks at Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached again at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 雍熙元年春正月壬子朔，不受朝，群臣詣閤拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: In Yongxi year one, spring, first month, on renzi, the new-moon day, he did not hold audience; the ministers went to the side gate, bowed, and submitted congratulatory tables.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon in the first month of Yongxi year one he withheld court audience while ministers offered New Year felicitations at the side gate.

sentences.zh: 戊午，右僕射石熙載薨。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Right Vice Director Shi Xizai died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu right vice director Shi Xizai died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，購逸書。

translations.literal: On renxu, lost books were sought by purchase.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he proclaimed rewards for recovering lost classical texts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，涪陵縣公廷美薨，追封涪陵王。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Duke of Fuling county Tingmei died and was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Fuling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao his brother Tingmei, Duke of Fuling, died and was posthumously made Prince of Fuling.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蠲諸州民去年官所貸粟。

translations.literal: On renshen, grain loaned last year by the government to commoners in the various prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he canceled last year's state grain loans across the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，左諫議大夫、參知政事李穆卒。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Left Reminder and participant councilor Li Mu died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou chief councilor Li Mu, left remonstrance official, died.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，滑州河決既塞，帝作平河歌賜近臣，蠲水所及州縣今年租。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingsi, after the Hua prefecture breach had been sealed, the emperor composed the Pacify-the-River song and bestowed it on close ministers, and this year's rent in flood-struck prefectures and counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi, once the Huazhou break was closed he wrote the Pacify-the-River song for his inner circle and remitted taxes in every flooded district.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以涪陵王子德恭、德隆為刺史，壻韓崇業為靜難軍司馬。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Tingmei's sons Degong and Delong were made prefects, and his son-in-law Han Chongye made Vice Director of the Jingnan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he appointed Tingmei's sons Degong and Delong prefects and his son-in-law Han Chongye vice director at Jingnan Army.

sentences.zh: 是月，甘露降太一宮庭。

translations.literal: That month, sweet dew fell in the courtyard of the Taiyi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That month sweet dew was reported in the Taiyi Palace courtyard.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，泰山父老詣闕請封禪。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yiyou, elders of Mount Tai came to court requesting the feng and shan sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, Taishan elders again petitioned for a fengshan rite.

sentences.zh: 戊子，群臣表請凡三上，許之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the ministers' memorials requesting it, thrice submitted, were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, after three rounds of ministerial pleas, he assented to the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 甲午，幸金明池，觀習水戰，因幸講武臺觀射，賜武士帛。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he visited Jinming Pool to watch naval drills, then visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Terrace to view archery and bestowed silks on the warriors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he reviewed the fleet at Jinming Pool, then watched archery at the Lecture Terrace and rewarded the bowmen with cloth.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌朔，除江南鹽禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengxu, the new-moon day, the salt monopoly in Jiangnan was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon in the fifth month he ended the Jiangnan salt ban.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸城南觀麥，賜刈者錢帛。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he visited the southern suburbs to view the wheat harvest and bestowed money and silks on the reapers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he rode south to inspect the wheat and gave cash and cloth to the harvesters.

sentences.zh: 罷諸州農師。

translations.literal: Agricultural instructors in the various prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He dissolved the prefectural agricultural instructor posts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，西州回鶻與波斯外道來貢。

translations.literal: On renzi, Gaochang Uyghurs and Persian heterodox faiths came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi envoys from Gaochang Uyghur and Persian heterodox communities presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，乾元、文明二殿災。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Qianyuan and Wenhua halls burned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou fire destroyed the Qianyuan and Wenhua halls.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以京官充堂後官。

translations.literal: On jimao, capital officials were made rear-hall attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he ordered metropolitan officials to serve as rear-hall secretaries.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，詔求直言。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dinghai, an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dinghai, he called for unsparing memorials on policy.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣使按察兩浙、淮南、西川、廣南獄訟。

translations.literal: On jichou, envoys were dispatched to investigate lawsuits in the Two Zhes, Huainan, Xichuan, and Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he sent commissioners to review prison cases in the Two Zhes, Huainan, Sichuan, and Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 鎮安軍節度使、守中書令石守信薨。

translations.literal: Military Commissioner of Zhen'an Army and Guardian of the Secretariat Shi Shouxin died.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shouxin, commissioner of Zhen'an Army and guardian of the secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，令諸州長吏十日一慮囚。

translations.literal: On gengzi, chief officials of the various prefectures were ordered to review prisoners every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he required every prefectural magistrate to inspect the jails once every ten days.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔罷封泰山。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict canceled the Mount Tai feng and shan sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he called off the planned fengshan at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，禁邊臣境外種蒔。

translations.literal: On jiachen, frontier officials were forbidden to plant crops beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he barred border commanders from farming land outside the line.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，改乾元殿為朝元殿，文明殿為文德殿，丹鳳門為乾元門；

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on renzi, the Qianyuan Hall was renamed Chaoyuan Hall, the Wenhua Hall Wende Hall, and the Vermilion Phoenix Gate Qianyuan Gate;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renzi, he renamed Qianyuan Hall Chaoyuan, Wenhua Hall Wende, and the Vermilion Phoenix Gate the Qianyuan Gate;

sentences.zh: 改匭院為登聞鼓院，東延恩匭為崇仁檢院，南招諫匭為思諫檢院，西申冤匭為申明檢院，北通玄匭為招賢檢院。

translations.literal: the Suggestion-Box Court was renamed Petition-by-Drum Court, the east Yan'en box the Chongren Review Court, the south Zhao Remonstrance box the Sijian Review Court, the west Shen Grievance box the Shenming Review Court, and the north Tongxuan box the Zhaoxian Review Court.
translations.idiomatic: the suggestion-box office became the Petition-by-Drum Court, the east Yan'en box the Chongren Review Office, the south remonstrance box the Sijian Review Office, the west grievance box the Shenming Review Office, and the north Tongxuan box the Zhaoxian Review Office.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，親祠太一宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou, he personally sacrificed at the Taiyi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, he offered sacrifice at the Taiyi Palace in person.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，河水溢。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Yellow River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Yellow River rose over its banks.

sentences.zh: 是月，淄州大水。

translations.literal: That month, Zi prefecture suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zizhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，群臣表三上尊號曰應運統天睿文英武大聖至仁明德廣孝皇帝，不許；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renxu, the ministers three times submitted tables offering the honorific title Responsive-to-Fate, Unifying Heaven, Sagaciously Literate, Heroically Martial, Greatly Sagely, Utterly Benevolent, Brightly Virtuous, Broadly Filial Emperor; he did not permit it;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, the court three times proposed the title Responsive-to-Fate, Unifying Heaven, Sagaciously Literate, Heroically Martial, Greatly Sagely, Utterly Benevolent, Brightly Virtuous, Broadly Filial Emperor, and he refused each time;

sentences.zh: 宰相叩頭固請，終不許。

translations.literal: the chief councilors kowtowed and pressed firmly, but in the end he did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: the chief councilors kowtowed and pleaded until he still would not accept.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸并河新倉。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he visited the new Bian River granary.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he inspected the new granary on the Bian Canal.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，賜華山隱士陳摶號希夷先生。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiashen, Mount Hua recluse Chen Tuan was given the style Sir Rarefied Peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiashen, he honored Mount Hua hermit Chen Tuan as Sir Rarefied Peace.

sentences.zh: 夏州言，掩擊李繼遷，獲其母妻，俘千四百餘帳，繼遷走。

translations.literal: Xia prefecture reported a surprise attack on Li Jiqian in which his mother and wife were captured and more than fourteen hundred households taken prisoner; Jiqian fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xiazhou reported a raid that seized Li Jiqian's mother and wife, took fourteen hundred tents captive, and drove Jiqian to flight.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁布帛不中度者。

translations.literal: On renchen, cloth and silk not meeting standard measure were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he banned sale of textiles that failed the official width and weight standards.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，嵐州獻牝獸一角，并瑞物六十三種圖付史館。

translations.literal: On guisi, Lan prefecture presented a horned female beast and a diagram of sixty-three kinds of auspicious objects, which were sent to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Lanzhou sent a one-horned female beast and a chart of sixty-three auspicious items for the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，忠州錄事參軍卜元幹坐受賕枉法，杖殺之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Zhong prefecture recorder Bu Yuangan, for taking bribes and perverting the law, was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Bu Yuangan, recorder at Zhongzhou, was flogged to death for bribery and corrupt judgment.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，高麗國王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi, the King of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Goryeo's king dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祀天地於圜丘，大赦，改元，中外文武官進秩有差。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the Round Mound; a great amnesty was proclaimed, the reign title changed, and civil and military officials within and without the court were promoted in graded ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Altar, proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the reign era, and advanced officials inside and outside the capital by graded steps.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以浦城童子楊億為秘書省正字。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Pucheng boy Yang Yi was made Regular Scribe of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the child prodigy Yang Yi of Pucheng was appointed regular scribe in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，淮海國王錢俶徙封漢南國王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, King of Huaihai Qian Chu was transferred in enfeoffment to King of Hannan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, Qian Chu was re-enfeoffed from king of Huaihai to king of Hannan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜京畿高年帛。

translations.literal: On guiwei, silks were bestowed on the aged of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he gave cloth to elderly subjects in the capital districts.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，罷嶺南採珠場。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Lingnan pearl-gathering grounds were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he shut down the Lingnan pearl fisheries.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，立德妃李氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On renchen, Worthy Consort Li was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he elevated Worthy Consort Li to empress.

sentences.zh: 丙申，御乾元門，賜京師大酺三日。

translations.literal: On bingshen, he took the Qianyuan Gate and bestowed a capital-wide feast for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he appeared at the Qianyuan Gate and granted the capital three days of public revelry.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大雨雪。

translations.literal: On wuxu, great rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu a heavy snowstorm swept the capital.
